deck-0003.jpg.title: Layla
deck-0003.jpg.bio: Born in Belgium with Iranian roots and raised between Sydney and Dubai, Layla left a corporate career to follow her dream, and it paid off. She was handpicked by Quincy Jones to perform at Q's Bar in Dubai, named Emirates Woman Artist of the Year in 2017 and won the Esquire Middle East Music Award in 2018. Her melodic riffs and rhythmic beats bring a rich, global sound and real star quality to any stage.

deck-0004.jpg.title: Aislu
deck-0004.jpg.bio: Originally from Kazakhstan and based in the UAE, Aislu moves effortlessly between jazz, soul and pop, captivating audiences with emotional depth and a natural stage presence. She holds a UAE Golden Visa in recognition of her contribution to the arts and is also a respected vocal coach. Whether performing solo or with musicians, she brings passion, polish and soul to every event, from elegant dinners to lively celebrations.

deck-0005.jpg.title: Alena R.
deck-0005.jpg.bio: A charismatic singer from Belarus with a powerful, beautifully controlled voice, Alena won the UAE TV show Win the Crowd in 2022 and was a grand finalist on the first season of The Vocalist UAE in 2024. She has performed across the UAE, Bahrain and Saudi Arabia, including for royal audiences and at Anantara hotels, and brings real sparkle to festive celebrations, galas and private events.

deck-0006.jpg.title: Bettina
deck-0006.jpg.bio: An award-winning opera singer and soprano from Vienna, now based in Dubai, Bettina has captivated audiences across Europe and the Middle East with her powerful voice and commanding stage presence. Her career spans performance, vocal consulting and design, giving her a rare blend of artistry and versatility. A stunning choice for gala dinners, weddings, cultural evenings and any occasion that calls for a touch of classical grandeur.

deck-0007.jpg.title: Alina H.
deck-0007.jpg.bio: Performing since 2014 and professionally since 2018, Alina has entertained audiences at five-star hotels, restaurants, clubs, festivals and beach parties across the UAE and Egypt. She performs as a solo artist, in vocal or vocal and instrument duos, or with a cover band. Guests love her engaging presence and the positive, elegant energy she brings, making her a reliable favourite for hotels, private parties and corporate events.

deck-0008.jpg.title: Claudia L.
deck-0008.jpg.bio: A classically trained vocalist from Spain, fluent in English, Spanish and French, Claudia sings everything from jazz standards and classic ballads to elegant arrangements of modern hits. Her voice is both sweet and powerful, and she delivers every song with grace and emotion. Refined, versatile and effortlessly elegant, she is a beautiful choice for weddings, dinners, receptions and luxury events.

deck-0009.jpg.title: Claudia P.
deck-0009.jpg.bio: A Dubai-based singer, songwriter and producer, Claudia is known for her soulful voice and honest, heartfelt music. She writes and produces her own songs exploring love, growth and self-discovery, and brings the same natural energy and connection to her live performances. With a fresh, personal sound and a growing presence on the Dubai music scene, she is a rising voice to watch for stylish events and intimate sets.

deck-0010.jpg.title: Ella
deck-0010.jpg.bio: A UAE-based singer and songwriter, Ella leads her own four-piece band, trio and duo, offering a live music experience that spans jazz, pop, soul and lounge. With a repertoire in several languages, she brings a global flair to every performance and performs regularly at venues across the UAE. A flexible choice that can scale from an intimate duo for dinner to a full band for the party.

deck-0011.jpg.title: Elnura
deck-0011.jpg.bio: A professional singer performing across Dubai and Abu Dhabi, Elnura is known for her powerful voice and magnetic stage presence. She brings energy, emotion and elegance to every performance, captivating audiences with her charisma and dynamic style. Whether on a big stage or in a more intimate setting, she delivers performances that leave a lasting impression on every guest.

deck-0012.jpg.title: Courtney
deck-0012.jpg.bio: A singer and actress based in Dubai, Courtney brings stories to life through powerful vocals and expressive performances. Her experience on both stage and screen gives her a natural ability to connect with an audience, combining emotion, skill and creativity in everything she does. A rising artist with talent and heart, she is a lovely choice for events that want warmth and personality.

deck-0013.jpg.title: Alisha
deck-0013.jpg.bio: A Dubai-based singer and songwriter, Alisha is known for her smooth vocals and expressive lyrics, blending passion and purpose in every song. With a creative spark that shines on and off the stage, she brings a fresh, modern perspective to her performances. A stylish choice for lounges, brand events and private parties looking for a contemporary, feel-good sound.

deck-0014.jpg.title: Alen
deck-0014.jpg.bio: An internationally recognised singer and songwriter, Alen has earned acclaim across Europe and the Middle East for his powerful voice and magnetic stage presence. He stood out on The Voice and X-Factor and was a finalist in a Eurovision 2018 national selection, performing to millions. With a distinctive style and real star quality, he brings excitement and polish to galas, concerts and celebrations.

deck-0015.jpg.title: Allexa
deck-0015.jpg.bio: A charismatic artist whose singing blends the enigmatic allure of Kate Bush with the emotional depth of Adele, Allexa has released her debut album Dark Angels and performed at Dubai's Expo and the city's most prestigious venues. Her music has been played on Virgin Radio Lebanon, Flouka Radio Paris and Dubai Eye. Classically trained and skilled in pop, rock and jazz, she delivers bold, unforgettable performances.

deck-0016.jpg.title: Anelly
deck-0016.jpg.bio: A UAE-based singer from Ukraine, trained in acting and vocal performance, Anelly has over 12 years of experience performing in Singapore, China, Indonesia, Turkey and the UAE. She has sung at venues including Hilton, Grand Millennium Dubai and Fairmont Abu Dhabi, for everything from wedding receptions to hotel bars and cocktail parties. Fluent in English, Spanish, Russian and Ukrainian, she brings charm and versatility to every event.

deck-0017.jpg.title: Anna Y.
deck-0017.jpg.bio: An internationally acclaimed singer from Ukraine, now based in Dubai, Anna performs pop, jazz, soul and lounge with a versatile voice and dynamic presence. Her sound combines the emotional depth of jazz, the smooth vibe of lounge and the energy of pop, and she has performed at renowned venues around the world. A polished choice for luxury venues, private events and corporate evenings.

deck-0018.jpg.title: Aston
deck-0018.jpg.bio: A South African multi-instrumentalist and singer-songwriter, Aston found fame on The Voice South Africa and is celebrated for his energetic live shows and clever looping, layering classic and modern hits into unique new versions. He has performed across South Africa and internationally, and his mix of musicianship and entertainment makes every set a memorable, one-man-band experience.

deck-0019.jpg.title: Bibi
deck-0019.jpg.bio: An Italian singer with a voice that enchants, BiBi brings timeless elegance to every stage, serenading guests at upscale events and exclusive venues around the world. Her style blends classic charm with contemporary flair, creating unforgettable moments with music that speaks to the heart. From private soirées to international galas, she adds a touch of magic and sophistication wherever she performs.

deck-0020.jpg.title: Charley
deck-0020.jpg.bio: A powerhouse performer with a rock 'n' roll spirit, Charley is an Irish singer, songwriter and guitarist known for raw vocals and magnetic energy. She fronts the band Warehouse11 and is a founding member of the girl band Heart Strings, blending grit with grace in every show. From packed venues to intimate acoustic sets, she commands the spotlight with fearless authenticity.

deck-0021.jpg.title: Dan M.
deck-0021.jpg.bio: A multi-talented Dubai-based musician, Dan blends acoustic guitar with innovative live looping to create a wide range of moods, from relaxed afternoon vibes to full party energy. He has held weekly residencies and performed at top venues including Time Out Market, Emirates Palace, Jumeirah Beach Hotel and Expo 2020, making him a trusted choice for hotels, brunches and private events.

deck-0022.jpg.title: DeniZa
deck-0022.jpg.bio: A dynamic, multifaceted artist with over five years of international touring across Hong Kong, China, Thailand and Macau, DeniZa has led her own shows as singer, producer and choreographer. She stood out on the TV vocal competition Battle of Covers in 2023 with performances full of K-pop flair and Marilyn Monroe-inspired glamour. With a range from jazz to rock and real stage charisma, she keeps audiences hooked from start to finish.

deck-0023.jpg.title: Dermott
deck-0023.jpg.bio: An Irish singer-songwriter and versatile cover artist, Dermott brings soulful sounds and heartfelt lyrics to stages across Dubai, Abu Dhabi and beyond. With warm vocals and an acoustic style, he connects with audiences through honest storytelling and timeless melodies, whether sharing his own songs or reimagining classics. A natural fit for relaxed venues, weddings and events with a warm, friendly feel.

deck-0024.jpg.title: Diana T.
deck-0024.jpg.bio: A soulful Dubai-based singer, Diana brings elegance, energy and emotion to every performance, with a repertoire in English, Spanish and Italian. She is a sought-after performer for luxury events, weddings and corporate occasions across the UAE, and her warm presence and multilingual charm help her connect with every audience, from intimate gatherings to grand celebrations.

deck-0025.jpg.title: Diana P.
deck-0025.jpg.bio: A professional singer and show and cabaret performer from Odesa, Diana has wowed audiences across the UAE, Georgia, Turkey and Ukraine with her captivating voice and magnetic stage presence. Her performances range from soulful ballads to high-energy cabaret acts, making her a versatile choice for themed nights, parties and events that want a touch of showbiz glamour.

deck-0026.jpg.title: Emily
deck-0026.jpg.bio: A British singer-songwriter based in Dubai, Emily is a full-time musician who performs her own music and also sings with a cover band. Her original songs carry Celtic tones and relatable, bittersweet lyrics, and she covers a wide range of styles for any audience. Fresh, engaging and full of feeling, she is a lovely choice for venues, weddings and private events.

deck-0027.jpg.title: Evgenia
deck-0027.jpg.bio: A talented vocalist and dynamic live performer, Evgenia brings a versatile mix of pop, jazz, lounge and rock to stages across Dubai and the UAE. Performing solo or with her band, she creates the perfect atmosphere for high-end corporate gatherings, private celebrations and lounge nights alike, moving from smooth jazz to energetic pop and rock hits to suit every setting.

deck-0028.jpg.title: Florentina
deck-0028.jpg.bio: A Dubai-based singer with a captivating voice, Florentina performs across many genres as a solo artist or with her dynamic band. From soulful ballads to upbeat hits, she and her band deliver energetic, engaging live shows that resonate with audiences, making her a flexible choice for everything from dinner sets to full party nights.

deck-0029.jpg.title: Idorka
deck-0029.jpg.bio: A Dubai-based vocalist known for her soulful tone, dynamic range and magnetic presence, Idorka brings elegance and energy to luxury events, private parties and top venues across the UAE. Her repertoire spans pop, soul, jazz and contemporary hits, and whether solo or with a live band, she knows exactly how to set the tone and lift the atmosphere.

deck-0030.jpg.title: Irina
deck-0030.jpg.bio: A Dubai-based singer performing professionally since 2013, Irina has an exceptionally wide repertoire covering lounge, jazz, soul, pop, rock, Latin, country, R&B, reggae, funk and disco. She has performed with live bands, in duos and trios, and now as a solo artist, and her dynamic presence suits both intimate settings and high-energy events.

deck-0031.jpg.title: Irina T
deck-0031.jpg.bio: Originally from Belarus and now based in Dubai, Irina performs solo, as a duo or as a trio, with a repertoire spanning pop, soul, jazz, lounge and dance music. Alongside English songs she also sings in French, Italian, Spanish and Russian, and her rich, captivating voice makes her a popular choice for hotels, restaurants and private events.

deck-0032.jpg.title: Itzel
deck-0032.jpg.bio: A Dubai-based singer and songwriter, Itzel blends emotion, elegance and power with a style that flows between pop, soul, R&B and acoustic sounds. Whether performing her own songs or reimagining well-loved covers, she captivates with soulful vocals and expressive presence. A natural storyteller, she is perfect for intimate performances, upscale events and everything in between.

deck-0033.jpg.title: Joel
deck-0033.jpg.bio: A singer, guitarist and DJ splitting his time between the UK and the UAE, Joel combines soulful vocals and rhythmic guitar with high-energy DJ sets under the name Hudson. From acoustic classics to full-band energy and turning up the vibe behind the decks, he moves seamlessly between live music and DJing, making him a brilliant all-in-one entertainer for venues and private parties.

deck-0034.jpg.title: Julia C.
deck-0034.jpg.bio: A dynamic and versatile singer based in Dubai, Julia brings elegance, emotion and energy to stages around the world. With a captivating voice and polished presence, she tailors every performance to the mood, from soulful ballads to upbeat hits, making her a perfect fit for luxury events, private functions and high-end venues.

deck-0035.jpg.title: Kate
deck-0035.jpg.bio: KT started out in intimate venues before making waves on Dubai's vibrant music scene, earning a loyal following with heartfelt lyrics and mesmerising melodies. Embracing her multicultural influences, she performs at high-profile events, collaborates with international artists and releases her own music. With a captivating voice and commanding presence, she brings fresh, soulful style to every stage.

deck-0036.jpg.title: Katarina
deck-0036.jpg.bio: A talented singer and violinist based in Dubai, Katarina blends vocal and instrumental music to create unique, enchanting performances. She performs at everything from private celebrations to corporate functions, adding elegance and energy to every occasion, and her two-in-one talent makes her a memorable choice for receptions, dinners and parties.

deck-0037.jpg.title: Kati
deck-0037.jpg.bio: Miss Kati has a remarkable, unforgettable voice that shines across soul, R&B, hip-hop, jazz, funk, soft rock, electro-pop and downtempo. Inspired by icons such as Amy Winehouse, Sade, Lauryn Hill, Adele and Erykah Badu, she interprets music with real depth and maturity, connecting emotionally with audiences through every lyric. A superb choice for stylish lounges and sophisticated events.

deck-0038.jpg.title: Kristina G.
deck-0038.jpg.bio: An award-winning singer from Belarus, now based in Dubai, Kristina has earned recognition for her powerful voice and dynamic stage presence. Her performances span many genres, and her versatility and emotional depth make her a standout artist on Dubai's music scene and a great choice for events of every style.

deck-0039.jpg.title: Kristina S.
deck-0039.jpg.bio: A Dubai-based vocalist and performer, Kristina sings jazz, pop, cabaret, Latin, swing, disco and blues, delivering world hits in her own original arrangements. She also writes and performs her own songs, teaches singing and works as an actress, regularly hosting theatre events in Dubai. Her versatility and flair make her ideal for themed nights, dinners and celebrations.

deck-0040.jpg.title: Kristine
deck-0040.jpg.bio: A soulful singer and songwriter based in Dubai, Kristine is known for her emotive voice, heartfelt lyrics and captivating presence. Her live sets mix soul, pop, acoustic and contemporary sounds, and her original songs combine personal storytelling with universal appeal. Authentic and passionate, she brings real feeling to every performance.

deck-0041.jpg.title: Raena
deck-0041.jpg.bio: A powerhouse British vocalist based in Dubai, Raena blends soul, jazz and funk with a voice that is rich, expressive and effortlessly cool. At luxury venues, private events and festival stages alike, she captivates with her warm tone, magnetic presence and undeniable groove, celebrating both classic and contemporary sounds.

deck-0042.jpg.title: La Rudche
deck-0042.jpg.bio: Known as the Demon Queen of Dubai, La Rudche is a powerhouse singer, songwriter and actress who fuses raw emotion, theatrical flair and magnetic artistry. Her work blends dark pop, soul, rock and performance art, with a voice that can haunt or heal. A bold, unforgettable choice for themed events, fashion nights and audiences who love something different.

deck-0043.jpg.title: Laura A.
deck-0043.jpg.bio: A vibrant Latin singer with a deep passion for the stage, Laura brings the magic of Latin, pop and jazz music to life. From restaurants and luxury hotels to weddings and yacht parties, she knows how to engage any audience and lift every event with her dynamic energy and soulful voice.

deck-0044.jpg.title: Lauren
deck-0044.jpg.bio: A heartfelt country singer and songwriter, Lauren writes music rooted in emotion, honesty and timeless storytelling. Her sound blends classic country charm with a modern twist, turning life's highs and lows into songs that feel both familiar and fresh. Warm, genuine and full of feeling, she is a wonderful choice for relaxed venues, weddings and country-themed events.

deck-0045.jpg.title: Lexie
deck-0045.jpg.bio: A singer, songwriter and trained dancer from the UK, Lexie has signed with Warner Music and Universal, released over ten records and featured on Spotify playlists including New Music Friday and Fresh Pop. She has performed over 300 concerts worldwide, including Coca-Cola Arena, Dubai Opera and Expo City, and toured internationally with electronic artist TSHA. Pop with a touch of soul and country, delivered with real star power.

deck-0046.jpg.title: Lia
deck-0046.jpg.bio: A professional singer and songwriter with 20 years in the music industry, Lia excels in pop, dance, lounge and jazz. She has collaborated with musicians, orchestras and dancers throughout her career, bringing dynamic, polished performances to a wide range of audiences and creating memorable moments at every event.

deck-0047.jpg.title: Lisi
deck-0047.jpg.bio: An acclaimed singer and songwriter nominated by Time Out, Lisi has performed across Turkey, Spain, India, Bahrain and Egypt and has been based in Dubai since 2017, playing top venues, Expo 2020 and MSC Cruises. Singing in Spanish, English and Portuguese, her repertoire covers salsa, bachata, bossa nova, samba, pop, jazz and afrobeat in solo to full-band formats. Lively, interactive and utterly reliable.

deck-0048.jpg.title: Massiel
deck-0048.jpg.bio: A Spanish-Cuban vocalist, saxophonist and trumpet player, Massiel combines serious musical training with a vibrant, playful and expressive style. Her repertoire spans jazz standards, R&B, Bruno Mars, rock, blues, rock and roll and Latin music, and she sings in Spanish, English, Portuguese, Arabic and Chinese. A multi-talented performer who brings colour and energy to any stage.

deck-0049.jpg.title: Nadin
deck-0049.jpg.bio: A dynamic Ukrainian artist based in Dubai, Nadin performs across the UAE and Qatar as a solo singer, in duos and with the high-energy Redline Band. With a powerful voice and captivating presence, she is also a voiceover artist, actress and model, bringing versatility, charisma and real star appeal to every event.

deck-0050.jpg.title: Natalia
deck-0050.jpg.bio: A singer from Belarus with a musical education and 11 years of experience, also trained in piano, Natalia performs upbeat, lounge, pop, rock, jazz, Latin and hits from the 70s, 80s and 90s. She works solo with backing tracks, in duos and trios, as a live band lead singer and as lead vocalist for dinner shows with dancers, making her a flexible choice for any event.

deck-0051.jpg.title: Nataly
deck-0051.jpg.bio: An international singer based in the Emirates, Nataly has been captivating audiences since 2012. Fluent in several languages, she blends genres effortlessly and has performed at five-star hotels, private parties, exhibitions, clubs, weddings, corporate events and restaurants worldwide. She connects with every audience and brings elegance, energy and flair to each performance.

deck-0052.jpg.title: Nathaniel
deck-0052.jpg.bio: A singer and songwriter with soulful vocals and heartfelt lyrics, Nathaniel crafts genre-blending music that is both powerful and personal. Beyond the stage he is a driven entrepreneur building projects that bring together music, culture and community, and he brings that same vision and authenticity to every performance.

deck-0053.jpg.title: Nonna
deck-0053.jpg.bio: A distinguished jazz and pop singer based in Dubai, Nonna is celebrated for her rich vocals, refined technique and elegant stage presence. As soloist with a jazz big band, she brings timeless classics and modern melodies to life with soulful style, and she is also a respected vocal teacher. Sophisticated yet accessible, she is ideal for concerts, galas and elegant events.

deck-0054.jpg.title: Polina Qz
deck-0054.jpg.bio: With a degree in jazz vocals and early training in violin, Polina moves effortlessly from jazz to opera and pop. Performing professionally since 2009, she has sung at the Byblos Festival in Lebanon, Dubai Opera with the Belcanto Jazz Band, in Qatar and at venues such as Nikki Beach and the Four Seasons in Thailand. A former contestant on The Voice and X Factor, she is a truly versatile performer.

deck-0055.jpg.title: Polina
deck-0055.jpg.bio: A celebrated singer and pianist based in Dubai, Polina holds a UAE Golden Visa and is a member of the Emirati Musicians' Association. Crowned Best Singer of the UAE in 2020 and honoured as a Celebrity Singer in 2023, she performs in French, English, Italian, Russian and Chinese, blending technical mastery with emotional depth at luxury events, private concerts and cultural showcases.

deck-0056.jpg.title: Sara T.
deck-0056.jpg.bio: A Dubai-based vocalist with an expressive voice and elegant style, Sara delivers powerful, emotional performances that suit luxury events, private functions and live venues. From soulful ballads and pop hits to acoustic classics, she brings authenticity and charm to every song and creates special musical moments for her audience.

deck-0057.jpg.title: Shanice
deck-0057.jpg.bio: With a career spanning Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Hong Kong, New York and Las Vegas, Shanice performs Motown, jazz, R&B, reggae and contemporary music with a distinctive voice and dynamic style. Based in the UAE since 2006, she has played top venues and private events, and earlier won 1st Runner-up on the TV show Born Diva along with several music award nominations.

deck-0058.jpg.title: Sophie
deck-0058.jpg.bio: A Dubai-based singer and songwriter with German and Slovenian roots, Sophie turned her passion for writing music into a full-time career. Known for her soft, dreamy voice and upbeat production, her new music blends pop and R&B to explore love in all its forms, from new romance to self-love. A fresh, modern choice for stylish venues and events.

deck-0059.jpg.title: Solé
deck-0059.jpg.bio: An Argentinian singer, songwriter and professional dancer now based in Dubai, Solé spent years performing in London, Los Angeles and Miami, working with names including Pitbull and James Maslow. Signed to Universal with her single Pachanta, she has performed at the iHeartRadio Music Awards in Las Vegas, the Viper Room in LA and Wembley Stadium. Latin fire with real international star quality.

deck-0060.jpg.title: Toi
deck-0060.jpg.bio: A singer, show creator and dancer based in Dubai, Toi combines music and dance to deliver dynamic, unforgettable live shows. With a strong creative vision and natural ability to captivate an audience, she brings energy, style and artistry to every performance, making her a standout choice for themed shows, parties and events.

deck-0061.jpg.title: TSaint
deck-0061.jpg.bio: A rising singer based in Dubai, TSaint blends R&B, pop and a touch of hip-hop into a fresh, soulful sound. Known for smooth vocals, catchy hooks and heartfelt lyrics about love, life and self-discovery, he is part of Dubai's growing wave of homegrown talent and connects with audiences through music that feels modern, global and real.

deck-0062.jpg.title: Vahimiti
deck-0062.jpg.bio: Born in Italy with a Tahitian heart and now based in Dubai, Vahimiti is a singer and songwriter whose multicultural roots shape every note. Her soulful melodies and global influences create a sound that feels timeless and borderless, and her performances are intimate yet powerful, a beautiful choice for elegant events and relaxed, atmospheric evenings.

deck-0063.jpg.title: Tina P.
deck-0063.jpg.bio: An international singer and TV presenter with roots in Kyiv and a presence in Dubai and London, Tina brings cosmopolitan flair to everything she does. Known for commanding vocals and a versatile style, she moves between genres with ease, and her presenting experience gives her a natural confidence and connection with any audience.

deck-0064.jpg.title: Toria
deck-0064.jpg.bio: A Dubai-based singer with a captivating voice, Toria blends pop, R&B and soul into a sound that really resonates with audiences. She has performed at prestigious venues and events across Dubai, earning recognition for her stage presence, vocal range and emotive delivery, and is one of the city's rising music stars.

deck-0065.jpg.title: Victoria
deck-0065.jpg.bio: A captivating soul and R&B artist, Victoria has a voice that is sultry, sophisticated and powerful all at once. A music college and university graduate with over 15 years of experience as a soloist and band singer, she has performed at renowned jazz festivals and clubs and recorded in the studio. Polished, emotive and memorable.

deck-0066.jpg.title: Sergio
deck-0066.jpg.bio: A Chilean musician, songwriter and singer, Sergio studied classical guitar at the National Conservatory of Music in Santiago and later specialised in popular music arrangement. His repertoire covers romantic ballads, jazz, flamenco fusion, Latin American music and pop. Based in the UAE since 2008, he has performed at Dubai Opera, Expo 2020 and many prestigious events.

deck-0067.jpg.title: Jay
deck-0067.jpg.bio: A singer and guitarist from the UK, Jay lights up Dubai's live music scene with smooth vocals, skilled guitar work and laid-back charm. His repertoire covers acoustic classics, pop, rock and indie favourites, and whether it's a chilled acoustic set or an upbeat night of crowd-pleasers, he brings a warm, engaging vibe to venues and private events.

deck-0068.jpg.title: Hamdan
deck-0068.jpg.bio: An Emirati singer-songwriter, Hamdan is a founder and frontman of the acclaimed Dubai soul band ABRI. The band released the much-loved albums Sunchild and Blank Notes and toured India, Bahrain, the UK and the Maldives, sharing stages with artists including Erykah Badu, Ziggy Marley, Kanye West and Joss Stone. A true pioneer of the UAE music scene.

deck-0069.jpg.title: Arianna
deck-0069.jpg.bio: Arianna began performing on Italian television as a child, fell in love with blues, jazz and soul as a teenager and went on to sing on Rai TV and for over a decade at Rome's famous Harry's Bar and venues across Europe and the USA. Based in Dubai since 2018, she performs across the Middle East solo and with her jazz trio, with a smooth, sophisticated sound.

deck-0070.jpg.title: Ryan
deck-0070.jpg.bio: A pianist, vocalist and actor with a real flair for entertaining, Ryan has performed in London's West End, on TV and commercials and on live tours, sharing stages with Andrew Lloyd Webber, Sir Tom Jones and will.i.am. Based in Dubai since 2022, he plays private events for high-profile clients with a repertoire that spans every genre.

deck-0071.jpg.title: Andrea
deck-0071.jpg.bio: Andrea has performed at private and public events around the world, from New York, Miami and Las Vegas to Paris, Saint-Tropez, London, Capri and Singapore. With a strong stage presence, impressive vocal range and solid experience in live performance, recording and songwriting, she connects with audiences and keeps the energy high in front of crowds of any size.

deck-0072.jpg.title: Arqam
deck-0072.jpg.bio: Born and raised in the UAE, Arqam is an Emirati soul singer who left the corporate world to make positive music. His sound blends old-school soul with neo-soul beats and lyrics about love, purpose and positivity, and his music is on Apple Music, Spotify and Deezer. A meaningful choice for national celebrations, cultural events and corporate occasions.

deck-0073.jpg.title: Eirini
deck-0073.jpg.bio: A UK R&B artist of Greek-Cypriot and British-Irish heritage, Eirini trained on a full scholarship at Stella Mann College and appeared in productions including FAME The Musical and at the Royal Albert Hall. In Dubai since 2019, she has performed at top venues and luxury brand events including Chanel and Porsche, and has released her own R&B and pop singles.

deck-0074.jpg.title: Lyndrik
deck-0074.jpg.bio: A singer, songwriter, producer and performer from Manchester, Lyndrik brings an energy reminiscent of Michael Jackson and Prince. He spent over a decade on London's West End, including leading roles in THRILLER Live, and has toured worldwide. With his unique voice and charisma, he leaves audiences spellbound at shows, galas and themed events.

deck-0075.jpg.title: Lina
deck-0075.jpg.bio: A Dubai-based R&B and soul singer from Germany, Lina won Netflix's Sing On! Germany in 2020 and has appeared on The Voice of Germany and All Together Now. She has worked with artists and labels including Robin Schulz, Guy Sebastian and Sony Music Germany, and performed at Expo 2020, the Forbes Middle East Healthcare Summit and a FIFA corporate dinner.

deck-0076.jpg.title: Jaymie
deck-0076.jpg.bio: Polished, emotive and introspective, Jaymie's music evokes foggy nights, heartbreak and intimate connection. Originally from Australia, he has been a fixture of the region's music scene for over seven years, embodying modern atmospheric R&B. Also an accomplished producer and songwriter, his records have passed 4.5 million streams.

deck-0077.jpg.title: Ayesha
deck-0077.jpg.bio: A Dubai-based singer-songwriter with soulful, captivating vocals, Ayesha grew up in a family that loved music. Influenced by R&B, soul and jazz, she has developed her own sound with heartfelt lyrics and emotive melodies that create a genuine connection with listeners. A rising star of Dubai's music community.

deck-0078.jpg.title: Chinua
deck-0078.jpg.bio: An award-winning singer and writer from New Jersey, Chinua has sung backing vocals for Celine Dion at Madison Square Garden and recorded with Kanye West on Talib Kweli's Get By. Raised on American soul and gospel, he has performed across North America, the Middle East, Africa, Asia, Europe and Central America, creating performances that uplift and inspire.

deck-0079.jpg.title: Julia S.
deck-0079.jpg.bio: Originally from Ukraine and performing in the UAE for over seven years, Julia trained at music college and a jazz and pop singing university in Poland. She has sung at venues including Waldorf Astoria, Four Seasons Jumeirah and Jumeirah Saadiyat, and her jazz, soul, pop and dance repertoire makes her a favourite for private events, weddings and yacht parties.

deck-0080.jpg.title: Bruno
deck-0080.jpg.bio: A music producer, artist and content creator working from his Dubai studio, Bruno made his name with the soulful house track Lose Myself with Sonny Fodera, followed by further collaborations and solo releases in electro-soul and contemporary R&B. On stage, from Fashion Forward to Formula 1 at Yas Marina, he performs with guitar, loop station and drum machine.

deck-0081.jpg.title: Sam T.
deck-0081.jpg.bio: With vibrant red hair, boho style and roots in South London, Sam is a singer-songwriter with a unique soul-pop sound, rich tones and jazzy melodies. She studied at the Academy of Contemporary Music in Guildford and travelled across Europe absorbing new influences, inspired by artists such as Esperanza Spalding and Lianne La Havas.

deck-0082.jpg.title: Sean
deck-0082.jpg.bio: An internationally acclaimed performer born in the US and raised in North Carolina, Sean began his solo career in Singapore in 2011 and has since performed in Bahrain, China, the Maldives and Dubai. His soulful R&B voice is rooted in church music, and he also plays drums, bass and keys and works as a producer.

deck-0083.jpg.title: Anastasia
deck-0083.jpg.bio: Known by her stage name MARUSHOVA, Anastasia brings a fresh, original sound to contemporary music, with an adventurous voice and a love of experimental sounds. A finalist on major TV talent projects, she has performed to crowds of thousands at events such as Moscow City Day, and her original songs are available on Spotify and Apple Music.

deck-0084.jpg.title: Diane
deck-0084.jpg.bio: An Irish-born singer with a 25-year career, Diane trained in musical theatre and has performed in West End tours, concerts and international events. Highlights include the FIFA World Cup 2022 in Qatar, tours with the Wellington and Honolulu Symphony Orchestras, the Royal Enclosure at the Jeddah F1 and the Endurance World Cup in Dubai for His Highness Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid.

deck-0085.jpg.title: Anna
deck-0085.jpg.bio: An independent artist from Odesa, Anna has performed at five-star hotels around the world including The Ritz-Carlton, Shangri-La, Sofitel, Mandarin Oriental and Kempinski. She sings pop, R&B, rock, Latin and jazz, and has 12 years of experience in duos, trios and 5 to 7-piece bands, including as lead singer of the Dubai party band Rhythm Nation.

deck-0086.jpg.title: Mary Louise
deck-0086.jpg.bio: A multi-talented Irish singer, model and actress, Mary-Louise is known for captivating performances and a stunning presence. With a versatile voice and a flair for entertaining, she has performed at some of Dubai's best venues and luxury events, combining music, style and charisma in a way that leaves a lasting impression.

deck-0087.jpg.title: Winck
deck-0087.jpg.bio: Born in southern Brazil and discovered on The Voice Brasil, Winck is a pop singer blending pop, funk and Latin influences. In Dubai she has been a special guest at TODA, the Digital Theatre at Souk Madinat Jumeirah, where her pop and jazz show has consistently sold out. Emotional, fun and full of energy, she draws audiences right into her world.

deck-0088.jpg.title: Maria
deck-0088.jpg.bio: An international singer and influencer, Maria is resident singer at the iconic Palazzo Versace Hotel. She has appeared on MBC1, sung at government events and royal weddings across the UAE, Expo 2020 and Middle East Fashion Week, and shared the stage with Amr Diab, Tamer Hosny and Cirque du Soleil. With nine years in the UAE and stages worldwide, she brings real glamour.

deck-0089.jpg.title: Anyuta
deck-0089.jpg.bio: A professional singer from Ukraine, Anyuta sings pop, jazz, lounge and blues with live musicians in duos, trios and bands. With extensive experience in variety, cabaret and burlesque shows, she also adapts easily to choreography. She has performed as a singer, dancer and actor in South Korea and China, and at popular Dubai venues, bringing charm and versatility to every show.

deck-0090.jpg.title: Nati
deck-0090.jpg.bio: A winner of international vocal competitions, Nati is regularly invited to perform as a soloist in Germany, Dubai, India, the Maldives, Turkey, Spain, Italy and France. Educated at the Kyiv Glier Institute and the Kyiv National University of Culture and Arts, she has worked on fine-dining show programmes and brings polish and international flair to every event.

deck-0091.jpg.title: Clare Sophia
deck-0091.jpg.bio: A British soul, jazz and R&B vocalist, Clare has toured internationally as a backing singer for Stormzy, Rita Ora and Kylie Minogue. Her London residencies included Mandarin Oriental, Park Chinois, Four Seasons, Soho House and Annabel's, and in Dubai she has worked with Van Cleef & Arpels, Elie Saab, Waldorf Astoria and FIVE, plus many luxury weddings and private events.

deck-0092.jpg.title: Alina
deck-0092.jpg.bio: A semi-finalist on The Voice of Ukraine and former lead soloist of the National Academic Symphonic Band of Ukraine, Alina has performed in the country's biggest concert halls and opened events such as the Vienna Ball in Kyiv. She has sung in Italy, Spain, Poland, the Netherlands and Kazakhstan, and brings powerful vocals and heartfelt interpretation to every stage.

deck-0093.jpg.title: Jade
deck-0093.jpg.bio: An international triple-threat, Jade sings party and rock anthems, creates the perfect jazz atmosphere and fronts production shows, adapting to jazz, pop, rock, house, musical theatre and cabaret. With 15 years of singing, dancing and hosting, she has performed across Europe, Africa and the Gulf, and can captivate a crowd of any size.

deck-0094.jpg.title: Aleksandra
deck-0094.jpg.bio: An award-winning pianist, singer, songwriter, composer and producer based in Dubai, Aleksandra holds a Master's in classical music from Belgrade. Her style blends jazz, funk, soul and electronic music, built on superb classical and jazz piano. She performs solo, leads her own jazz, funk and soul band and collaborates with DJs and regional artists.

deck-0095.jpg.title: Luba
deck-0095.jpg.bio: A jazz singer trained as a pop-jazz vocalist at Kyiv National University of Culture and Arts, Luba has performed at top venues in Ukraine, China, Cyprus and Dubai, including Sheraton Guangzhou and Hilton Garden Inn Hong Kong. Her styles include lounge, jazz, pop, retro and classic rock, and her musical theatre experience in Cats and Chicago gives her real stage presence.

deck-0096.jpg.title: Ingrid
deck-0096.jpg.bio: A Lebanese singer trained in opera at the Lebanese Higher Conservatory and in contemporary styles at Berklee College of Music, Ingrid has performed at the Beirut and jazz festivals, on TV's Celebrity Duets and at events including Cartier at Expo 2020 and Richard Mille Desert Polo. A UAE Golden Visa holder and vocal coach, she brings elegance and range to every event.

deck-0097.jpg.title: July
deck-0097.jpg.bio: An international singer from Belarus with 15 years of experience, July is known for creating a heart-to-heart atmosphere full of joy. She sings pop, rock, blues, jazz, funk, country, disco and soul from a playlist of over 350 hits, and leads several projects including a band. Her background as an MC also makes her a natural with any crowd.

deck-0098.jpg.title: Carla
deck-0098.jpg.bio: An Italian jazz and bossa nova vocalist with a soulful, refined voice, Carla holds a degree in music therapy and has extensive jazz training. While jazz is her heart, collaborations across genres let her tailor a repertoire for any audience, from intimate gatherings to larger events, always delivered with depth and emotion.

deck-0099.jpg.title: Alina P.
deck-0099.jpg.bio: Originally from Kazakhstan, Alina is a professional singer with ten years of experience working with musicians across Asia, the Middle East and Europe. She performs pop, jazz, rock, blues and hip-hop, collaborates with DJs and has written and released her own techno-house and pop songs.

deck-0100.jpg.title: Angel
deck-0100.jpg.bio: Angel began studying music at six in Greece, starting with classical piano, singing lead in her local choir and later adding saxophone with top philharmonic bands in Athens. She studied opera and orchestration at the Athens Conservatory, giving her a rich, versatile musicianship that shines in elegant, sophisticated performances.

deck-0101.jpg.title: Lisa
deck-0101.jpg.bio: A fearless songwriter and performer, Lisa has had twelve songs aired internationally, was named Top Emerging Artist in the UAE in 2019 and reached No.1 on Heart FM with Kept In A Locket. She has performed in London, Ibiza, Dubai and Asia, sharing stages with Ed Sheeran, Jessie J and Scouting For Girls, and writes music that touches hearts.

deck-0102.jpg.title: Dario
deck-0102.jpg.bio: An Italian classic pop singer with a touch of opera, Dario began studying music in Sicily at six. With a strong, powerful voice and wide repertoire, he has performed in Italy, the UAE, Bahrain and Greece at conventions, weddings, parties, yachts and clubs, and can perform as a duo with a female singer or musician.

deck-0103.jpg.title: Eleonora
deck-0103.jpg.bio: An Italian singer from Verona now based in Dubai, Eleonora trained in New York, performed in musicals including We Will Rock You and Peter Pan, and appeared on X Factor Italy. She has been the voice of Billionaire Dubai and represented Italy at the Tolerance Award 2021 at Dubai Opera, bringing theatrical flair and real vocal power.

deck-0104.jpg.title: Yvonne
deck-0104.jpg.bio: Born and raised in London, Yvonne started singing in her church choir and went on to earn a vocal degree from the Academy of Contemporary Music. Her soulful, unique tone and impressive range have seen her perform alongside award-winning artists at prestigious venues worldwide, often with her versatile three or four-piece band.

deck-0105.jpg.title: Laura V.
deck-0105.jpg.bio: Born in Portugal with Brazilian roots, Laura delivers powerhouse performances blending soul, R&B, pop, jazz and samba. With over ten years of experience, formal jazz training and an appearance on The Voice Portugal, she performs from intimate duos to full bands at weddings, hotels, festivals and corporate events with contagious energy.

deck-0106.jpg.title: Kerrie
deck-0106.jpg.bio: A singer, saxophonist and artist manager with over 15 years in music, Kerrie holds a BA in Popular Music and has performed at five-star hotels across Europe, Asia, Australia and the Middle East. In the UAE since 2018, she has entertained VIP audiences at Expo 2020 and the Abu Dhabi Grand Prix, and leads her own energetic, versatile band.

deck-0107.jpg.title: Mary
deck-0107.jpg.bio: A Dubai-based singer with over ten years of experience and a former contestant on The Voice of Ukraine, Mary has performed at The Theater at Fairmont, Verde Beach and Seafire at Atlantis, as well as in the Philippines, South Korea, Turkey and China. A trained musician and vocal coach, she is versatile across many genres.

deck-0108.jpg.title: Iva
deck-0108.jpg.bio: A Dubai-based soul, jazz, pop and dance singer, Iva has performed at Atlantis The Royal, Burj Al Arab, Four Seasons, Bulgari Yacht Club and FIVE Palm Jumeirah, and at events for Valentino, Van Cleef & Arpels, TikTok and DAMAC. From private parties and gala dinners to TV and opera houses, she brings class and energy to every stage.

deck-0109.jpg.title: Inga
deck-0109.jpg.bio: An Armenian-Polish singer, songwriter and performer, Inga is fluent in Armenian, English, Russian and Polish. She has appeared on The Voice of Armenia and The Voice of Poland and won two international music competitions in Europe. Her love of dance adds real dynamism to her shows, creating captivating performances that bridge cultures.

deck-0110.jpg.title: Luna
deck-0110.jpg.bio: Originally from Cuba and now based in Dubai, Luna draws on Cuba's vibrant musical traditions and has performed in China, Vietnam, Egypt and Oman. Her versatile voice spans jazz, soul and pop, and her captivating presence and genuine passion turn every performance into a joyful, memorable experience.

deck-0111.jpg.title: Roxanne Duo
deck-0111.jpg.bio: A fierce Lebanese performer, Roxanne moves effortlessly between R&B, soul, pop, disco and jazz with vocals that are both sultry and powerful. A former guest performer at Le Speakeasy in Paris, she moved to Dubai in 2021 and has appeared at venues including Bagatelle, The Nice Guy, Indochine and ONZE. Equally at home setting a laid-back mood or starting the party.

deck-0113.jpg.title: The Swing Revue
deck-0113.jpg.bio: Formed in Dubai in 2014, The Swing Revue brings the vibrant sound of swing and the golden era of the 1920s to the 1950s to life. With musicians from the Philippines, England, Australia and Armenia, their high-energy shows are full of solos, harmonies and personality, guaranteed to leave smiles on faces and get feet tapping.

deck-0114.jpg.title: Gorgeous George
deck-0114.jpg.bio: More than a band, Gorgeous George is a full-throttle live music experience and a staple of Dubai's nightlife. With explosive energy, genre-bending setlists and magnetic presence, they play rock and indie anthems, funk, pop and crowd-shaking classics that keep dance floors packed, from bar nights to private parties and festival stages.

deck-0115.jpg.title: The Bossa Project
deck-0115.jpg.bio: Led by vocalist Andrea, who has performed from New York and Los Angeles to Paris and Singapore, The Bossa Project blends Brazilian and English songs with the rhythms of Rio de Janeiro. Smooth, stylish and full of sunshine, they are perfect for brunches, receptions, pool parties and sophisticated evenings.

deck-0116.jpg.title: The Nomads
deck-0116.jpg.bio: A high-energy band with a fresh fusion of pop, rock and feel-good vibes, The Nomads aren't confined by genre or geography. Catchy melodies, driving beats and lots of heart make every show bold, uplifting and impossible not to dance to, whether it's a festival crowd or an intimate venue.

deck-0117.jpg.title: Nutella Riot
deck-0117.jpg.bio: A Dubai-based pop and jazz band, part funk and part swing, Nutella Riot play jazzy, upbeat covers of classics and current English and French favourites. They have performed in over 50 cities from Glastonbury Festival to the Cologne Philharmonic, had videos screened on MTV and composed for theatre and BBC documentaries. A truly unique sound.

deck-0118.jpg.title: Noon Band
deck-0118.jpg.bio: An instrumental trio that captures the cosmopolitan spirit of the Emirates, NOON puts the oud up front, framed by electric bass and drums and freed by the improvisation of jazz. Their East-meets-West sound is fresh, sophisticated and atmospheric, ideal for cultural events, elegant dinners and audiences who love something different.

deck-0119.jpg.title: Hosny Fusion Trio
deck-0119.jpg.bio: This dynamic trio brings the rich heritage of Arabic music together with modern influences, featuring a virtuoso oud player, a versatile pianist and a talented percussionist. Rooted in traditional melodies and rhythms, their seamless interplay creates a captivating fusion of classical and contemporary sounds.

deck-0120.jpg.title: Golden Collective
deck-0120.jpg.bio: One of the most sought-after party bands in Dubai and the Middle East, Golden Collective features a charismatic London vocalist, a horn section from Los Angeles and Havana and world-class musicians from Europe. They work closely with clients to curate the perfect setlist for corporate and luxury events, with energy, sound and style to match.

deck-0121.jpg.title: Nuvo Soul
deck-0121.jpg.bio: Soulful, seductive and sublime. Shortlisted for Best Live Band at Time Out Dubai's Nightlife Awards in 2018 and 2022 and named Abu Dhabi's best band in 2019, Nuvo Soul blends jazz, soul and funk, inspired by legends like Ella Fitzgerald and Frank Sinatra and modern icons like Amy Winehouse and Bruno Mars. With Carrie on vocals, Joseph on keys and Lance on drums, they read the room and tailor every set, so it's hard to stay still.

deck-0122.jpg.title: The Moxies
deck-0122.jpg.bio: Step back to the roaring 1920s with The Moxies, an all-female vocal harmony trio. With tight harmonies, elegant choreography and vintage style, they serenade guests with modern and vintage tunes. These experienced Dubai performers have appeared at Dubai Opera and on The Voice Bulgaria, adding a touch of nostalgia and glamour to any event.

deck-0123.jpg.title: The Youngers
deck-0123.jpg.bio: Formed in Dubai in 2017, The Youngers are an acoustic trio known for wandering among guests and making them part of the show. Performing completely live in English, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian and some Arabic, they are a perfect fit for theme nights, weddings, business events and any occasion that needs warmth and interaction.

deck-0124.jpg.title: Lady J
deck-0124.jpg.bio: Lady J and her musical partner Felix have performed over 2,700 shows across Asia and the GCC since 2006, and have been a favourite on Dubai's live music scene since 2015. Moving effortlessly from high-energy pop covers to an intimate jazz duo, they blend live drum loops, guitar and tambourine with French classics, Motown and pop hits. Every show is an emotional journey through nostalgic favourites and exciting new sounds.

deck-0125.jpg.title: 4TheMusic
deck-0125.jpg.bio: An award-winning Dubai-based band from South Africa, 4TheMusic won What's On Best Band 2023 and a Best World Beat award in Los Angeles. With 16 years performing across Dubai and the Middle East and appearances on MBC1, Dubai Eye and SABC, they are known for energising crowds at every kind of event.

deck-0126.jpg.title: Salt & Pepper Duo
deck-0126.jpg.bio: A polished duo with Kevin on vocals and Donovan on piano, Salt & Pepper bring years of experience in performing, arranging and staging themed shows. Using backing tracks to complement their live sound, they cover pop, dance, R&B, jazz, classical and ballads, and are known in Dubai for a professional approach that keeps guests coming back.

deck-0127.jpg.title: De Cruz Band
deck-0127.jpg.bio: Originally from West Africa and based in Dubai since 2015, De Cruz Band is a versatile ensemble performing jazz, Motown, soul, reggae and Afrobeats. They have shared the stage with stars including Akon, Wizkid, Davido, Mi Casa, Patoranking, Tekno and Mr P of P-Square, and perform regularly at luxury hotels and venues across the UAE. Equally brilliant as a trio or a full band, they bring a joyful, dance-floor-filling energy to any event.

deck-0128.jpg.title: The Boxtones
deck-0128.jpg.bio: A multi-award-winning Scottish and Canadian rock and pop band signed to Universal Music MENA, The Boxtones blend popular rock with a subtle Celtic flavour and pounding rhythms. Based in the UAE, they have performed alongside Liam Gallagher, The Chemical Brothers, Stereophonics, Pharrell Williams, The Who, Blur and Florence and the Machine.

deck-0129.jpg.title: About Last Night
deck-0129.jpg.bio: About Last Night put on a show. Their stadium-style performances feature carefully curated setlists packed with cheeky mash-ups and clever arrangements, plus time-coded light and video shows you won't find with any other band in the UAE. High-energy, room-jumping fun, from serious musicians who can also tailor their style to any event.

deck-0130.jpg.title: Nomades The Band
deck-0130.jpg.bio: Nomades The Band blends eclectic traditional music from across cultures with contemporary rhythms, using voice, guitar, kanun, oud, bouzouki, percussion, keys and electronics. The result is an uplifting, grounding musical journey that lets guests dance and unwind as the sun sets, perfect for desert events, beach gatherings and cultural evenings.

deck-0131.jpg.title: Mr and Mrs Duo
deck-0131.jpg.bio: A married duo based in the UAE, Mr & Mrs blend saxophone and soulful vocals. Daniel's smooth sax spans jazz, soul, classic pop and disco, while Naomi's powerhouse voice shines on jazz ballads and timeless pop. Inspired by jazz legends, soul icons and the golden era of disco, they create a warm, romantic sound perfect for weddings and receptions.

deck-0132.jpg.title: Danny & Krystle Duo
deck-0132.jpg.bio: A married couple with years of musical collaboration, Krystle from Canada and Danny from the UK bring soulful energy and heartfelt vocals to every performance. Blending their different backgrounds into a harmonious sound, they captivate audiences from intimate venues to larger stages and make every show a memorable journey.

deck-0133.jpg.title: The Girl From The North Country
deck-0133.jpg.bio: Led by UK singer Lauren, The Girl From The North Country is a duo known for quirky personality and infectious energy. Blending soulful depth with playful charm, their repertoire runs from soulful ballads to upbeat anthems, making every show a fun, emotional journey that suits venues, weddings and private parties.

deck-0134.jpg.title: The Ark Angels
deck-0134.jpg.bio: Girls just wanna have fun, and that's exactly what this four-piece band does. Bursting onto Dubai's entertainment scene with lively energy, infectious rhythms and feel-good music, The Ark Angels blend pop and rock into a dynamic show and play some of the UAE's busiest venues.

deck-0135.jpg.title: Big Mouth
deck-0135.jpg.bio: Dubai's hottest power trio, Big Mouth deliver top-level musicianship, insane guitar work and a tight rhythm section, playing timeless classics that keep audiences dancing and singing all night. Their mission is simple: make sure everyone has the best time, every time.

deck-0136.jpg.title: Carla Duo
deck-0136.jpg.bio: Led by Italian jazz and bossa nova vocalist Carla, this duo brings a soulful, refined sound with deep emotion and real jazz craft. While jazz is at its heart, the repertoire spans many genres so it can be tailored to any audience, from intimate dinners to larger celebrations.

deck-0137.jpg.title: Jose Jazz Trio
deck-0137.jpg.bio: Led by pianist, trombonist and composer Jose, this acclaimed jazz trio specialises in Latin-Arabic fusion mixed with classical and Afro-Cuban influences. Jose has performed at top international festivals, and the band's intricate rhythms and melodic lines create a dynamic, innovative and engaging musical experience.

deck-0138.jpg.title: Bobby Jazz Trio
deck-0138.jpg.bio: Singer, pianist and trumpeter Bobby and his trio turn your favourite hits into lyrical jazz magic, with the best of Tony Bennett, Frank Sinatra and Michael Bublé performed on grand piano. Mellow, stylish and never the same twice, the trio is perfect for intimate venues, cocktail hours and large-scale events alike.

deck-0139.jpg.title: Errico Jazz Band
deck-0139.jpg.bio: Born in Naples, Errico studied music composition and has performed at events across Europe, including for high-profile guests in England and as a backing vocalist on an extended Mexican tour. Now leading his own jazz band, he brings classic Italian charm and polished musicianship to elegant events.

deck-0140.jpg.title: Rudo Jazz Trio
deck-0140.jpg.bio: A pop-jazz trio created by three-time SAMA Award-nominated arranger and composer Rudo on upright bass and vocals, with Joel on piano and Janelle on drums. They have shared stages with John Legend, Alicia Keys and Gregory Porter and opened for Beyoncé. Their foot-tapping jazz reinventions of five decades of hits make for a fun, fresh evening.

deck-0141.jpg.title: Chloe Jazz Trio
deck-0141.jpg.bio: British soul and jazz singer Chloe grew up on Natalie Cole, Stevie Wonder, Whitney Houston, Ella Fitzgerald and Amy Winehouse, and it shows in her soulful, sultry, velvety tone. Signed to a major label at 16, she has performed across the UK for Rick Astley and Kid Creole, and now leads her own jazz trio.

deck-0142.jpg.title: Mark
deck-0142.jpg.bio: A swing crew that will energise even the sleepiest crowd. With a sharp, engaging sound, warm and versatile vocals and a passionate brass section, this young band of top music-academy graduates plays vigorous jazz and swing with youthful swagger and serious skill. Perfect for parties, galas and vintage-themed nights.

deck-0143.jpg.title: Cubache Band
deck-0143.jpg.bio: Nominated for Best Bar Band at the 2018 Time Out Dubai Awards, Cubache is a six-piece band of Cuban musicians passionate about keeping Cuban traditions alive. Their authentic mix of Latin and Afro rhythms brings the vibrant sound of Buena Vista and salsa to life, guaranteed to get guests on the dance floor.

deck-0144.jpg.title: IVA
deck-0144.jpg.bio: A Dubai-based soul, jazz, pop and dance singer, Iva has performed at Atlantis The Royal, Burj Al Arab, Four Seasons, Bulgari Yacht Club and FIVE Palm Jumeirah, and at events for Valentino, Van Cleef & Arpels, TikTok and DAMAC. From private parties and gala dinners to TV and opera houses, she brings class and energy to every stage.

deck-0145.jpg.title: Mike & Mary Duo
deck-0145.jpg.bio: Mike & Mary perform as a duo, a trio or with their Star Band, with voices that have featured on The Voice of Ukraine, X Factor and Sing All. Their repertoire runs from classics of the 1940s and 50s to modern dance hits, so they can soundtrack every part of your event with style.

deck-0147.jpg.title: Mo
deck-0147.jpg.bio: Originally from California and based in Dubai, Mo is a master of ceremonies with 15 years of experience hosting corporate functions, public events and government ceremonies for some of the largest companies in the UAE and GCC. He connects naturally with audiences and creates exciting, interactive and memorable experiences for every attendee.

deck-0148.jpg.title: Ali
deck-0148.jpg.bio: A cornerstone of Dubai's entertainment scene, Ali launched Viva Dubai in 2004, the UAE's first English online entertainment magazine, and co-founded Viva Arts and Dubomedy. Now a comedian, MC and producer, he has hosted major events including the FIVB World Beach Volleyball Championship and FIFA Beach Soccer World Cup qualifiers.

deck-0149.jpg.title: Bassam
deck-0149.jpg.bio: Between Dubai and Lebanon, music has always been at Bassam's heart. Now one of the best-known MCs in the UAE, he performs at events alongside popular artists and bands, and his multilingual skills make him a natural with every audience. Clients include Lamborghini, TikTok, FIFA and Majid Al Futtaim.

deck-0150.jpg.title: Nour
deck-0150.jpg.bio: An award-winning TV presenter with nearly 17 years in media, Nour holds a degree in mass communication and won Best Khaliji Presenter in 2013. He began on Dubai TV, interviewed prominent Arab personalities and has anchored programmes on Al Jazeera. A polished bilingual host for conferences, ceremonies and high-profile events.

deck-0151.jpg.title: Hassan
deck-0151.jpg.bio: An entertaining and reliable host fluent in English and Arabic, Hassan is equally at home at a formal corporate event or a fun quiz night. He ran the stage at the German Pavilion at Expo 2020 for six months, hosted RIT Dubai's graduation ceremony two years running and hosted competitions at Automechanika at the World Trade Centre.

deck-0152.jpg.title: Elias
deck-0152.jpg.bio: Originally from Lebanon and in the UAE for over 11 years, Elias is an MC, voiceover artist, actor and filmmaker. He has been the face and voice of live shows including dolphin, seal and bird shows, corporate and public events, and private gatherings, and brings warmth and professionalism to every stage.

deck-0153.jpg.title: Abdullah
deck-0153.jpg.bio: A charismatic Emirati host and emcee, Abdullah combines an engineering background with a love of comedy, bringing professionalism and humour to every event. His experience as a TV presenter and actor helps him keep energy high and events flowing smoothly, from corporate conferences to entertainment shows.

deck-0154.jpg.title: Hassan H.
deck-0154.jpg.bio: An Emirati master of ceremonies, speaker on responsible AI and the future of work, and wealth manager, Hassan has led AI-driven digitisation projects across banking and beyond. A multilingual communicator passionate about ESG and inclusion, he makes complex topics accessible, ideal for tech, finance and innovation events.

deck-0155.jpg.title: Alex
deck-0155.jpg.bio: A British TV presenter, DJ and event host, Alex has compered large-scale events including the Challenge Cup Final and the Six Nations fan zone, and presented for Premier Sports and Made TV. As a DJ he reads a crowd brilliantly, making him a great two-in-one choice for sports events, festivals and private parties.

deck-0156.jpg.title: Chris
deck-0156.jpg.bio: Known as Sibbers, Chris is a radio personality with over 15 years of experience and two Sony Gold Awards. In Dubai he hosts quiz nights, MCs major events such as New Year's Eve at Barasti and appears regularly at Topgolf Dubai, and he has been a stadium announcer for teams including Newcastle United and England Rugby.

deck-0157.jpg.title: Darryl
deck-0157.jpg.bio: An engaging host with a unique sense of humour and quick wit, Darryl connects with guests of all ages and brings them together in laughter and applause. With a background in radio, sports and entertainment, he is an ideal compere for trade shows, expos, music festivals, brand activations and corporate functions.

deck-0158.jpg.title: Scotty
deck-0158.jpg.bio: A British MC and host, Scotty started as a DJ in 1992, joined the Ministry of Sound family and worked with Hed Kandi before moving to Dubai in 2011. Now a go-to host for quiz nights, music bingo, karaoke and major fan zones for the FIFA World Cup and European Championships, he brings big energy and fun.

deck-0159.jpg.title: Sawsan
deck-0159.jpg.bio: A TV presenter on Dubai Sports and the first Arab official FIFA and UAE stadium commentator, Dr Sawsan has over 11 years in sports media and a doctorate in sports media. Mastering several accents and languages, she is a renowned presenter across the GCC and MENA and has been official commentator and MC for major FIFA events.

deck-0160.jpg.title: Salma
deck-0160.jpg.bio: A bilingual MC and host who captivates audiences in English and Arabic, Salma has a background in business and marketing and a successful career as a celebrity makeup artist. Her creativity and professionalism make her an ideal host for corporate functions, product launches, beauty and fashion events.

deck-0161.jpg.title: Dija
deck-0161.jpg.bio: A dynamic bilingual MC and presenter, Dija brings energy, charisma and professionalism to events in English and Arabic. She has hosted the AZIZI Developments Gala, Leadership Summit Awards, Gulfood and Dubai Muscle Show, and covers corporate functions, product launches, sports and community events.

deck-0162.jpg.title: Andreea
deck-0162.jpg.bio: A speaker, presenter and speech coach who has lived and studied in London, Los Angeles and Dubai, Andreea is the face and voice of international brands in Dubai. After years mastering the art of communication and speaking to thousands, she brings polish and presence to conferences, launches and corporate events as an MC.

deck-0163.jpg.title: Laura
deck-0163.jpg.bio: An experienced British TV and radio presenter and events host based in Dubai, Laura is on air with Dubai 92 and has hosted red carpets, corporate events, award ceremonies, fashion shows, sporting and family events and weddings, including the New Year's Eve countdown at Burj Al Arab and Jumeirah Beach Hotel.

deck-0164.jpg.title: Lorna
deck-0164.jpg.bio: Hosting on radio, TV and events since 2003, Lorna is a familiar voice across the UAE, working with Global, Shock ME and ARN and appearing on Dubai 92. She hosts ceremonies, mall events, children's parties and quiz nights, runs her own weekly kids' brunch and has worked with clients including Expo 2020.

deck-0165.jpg.title: Jade
deck-0165.jpg.bio: A radio presenter on Channel 4 104.8 and a skilled MC and DJ, Jade can entertain a crowd from the decks and the microphone at the same time. She has hosted award shows, sports events, brunches and pool parties, including MC roles at F1 Abu Dhabi, the Dubai Marathon and Expo Young Stars.

deck-0166.jpg.title: Alexandra
deck-0166.jpg.bio: A renowned Canadian conference MC and panel moderator based in Dubai, Alexandra brings over 25 years of experience across North America, Southeast Asia, Africa and the MENA region. With wit, warmth and expertise, she sets the stage for meaningful dialogue and is a sought-after host in Dubai, Riyadh and Doha.

deck-0167.jpg.title: Shwetha
deck-0167.jpg.bio: Hosting since 2008, Shwetha has emceed celebrity events, concerts, conferences, product launches, award ceremonies and press conferences. Fluent in English, Hindi and Kannada, she has hosted Dubai movie promotions with star casts and the Dubai Fitness Challenge alongside former Chelsea captain John Terry.

deck-0169.jpg.title: Parvané
deck-0169.jpg.bio: A Dubai-based creative of French-Iranian roots, Parvané is a DJ, model, creative director and photographer who has collaborated with many local and international brands. Her DJ sets reflect her multicultural background, moving from Miami bass and breakbeat to electronic and house, perfect for fashion, brand and lifestyle events.

deck-0170.jpg.title: Joanna
deck-0170.jpg.bio: A Dubai-based DJ known for versatile, soulful house sets, Joanna blends genres seamlessly to create an immersive experience. She adapts to any event, from high-energy club nights to elegant private gatherings, and has played some of Dubai's most prestigious venues, including FIVE Palm Jumeirah's Penthouse and Praia.

deck-0171.jpg.title: Akmaral
deck-0171.jpg.bio: A globally acclaimed DJ and producer based in Dubai and Abu Dhabi, Akmaral plays high-energy open-format sets blending electronic, house, techno, Afrobeats, Latin and pop. She has performed at the Formula 1 Grand Prix, NBA games at Etihad Arena, FIFA events and the Rugby Sevens, as well as major festivals.

deck-0172.jpg.title: Yava
deck-0172.jpg.bio: Originally from Ukraine and in the UAE since 2014, Yava is a DJ and producer known for deep, organic, Afro and Latin house. She has played renowned Dubai venues including Soho Garden, BO18, Cavo, Coda and Praia, creating infectious, immersive atmospheres wherever she performs.

deck-0173.jpg.title: Viola
deck-0173.jpg.bio: An internationally acclaimed DJ and producer based in Dubai, Viola combines a background in classical violin and jazz with contemporary DJing. Founder of the Phantom Project party series, she blends indie dance, melodic techno, Afro and progressive house into sets that are original, immersive and full of energy.

deck-0174.jpg.title: Cascou
deck-0174.jpg.bio: A Kuwaiti-born DJ and producer and an original presenter on Radio Alhara, Cascou pays meticulous attention to detail, from Balearic, acid and tabla-laced selections to his nostalgic 3D visuals. He launched the PARADISEA label and party series at XP Music Futures to champion up-and-coming DJs and visual artists.

deck-0175.jpg.title: Sonya
deck-0175.jpg.bio: A tour de force behind the decks, Sonya has played some of the biggest stages in the region, from Expo 2020 to opening for Bruno Mars at Du Arena and DJing the launch of Ain Dubai. Known for strong programming and timeless sets, she brings glamour and energy to every event.

deck-0176.jpg.title: Sara
deck-0176.jpg.bio: A professional house and techno DJ with a deep love of underground electronic music, Sara spins both digital and vinyl for an authentic touch. Her sets blend classic house grooves with modern techno beats, creating an immersive experience, and she has played top venues and festivals with real technical skill and infectious energy.

deck-0177.jpg.title: Bambi
deck-0177.jpg.bio: Originally from St Petersburg, Bambi built her name with residencies at her hometown's most renowned venues before moving to Dubai. Here she has played for Soho Family venues, URBAN and Lux49, and is a resident at Summersalt Beach Club, bringing dynamic, crowd-pleasing sets to clubs, beach clubs and private events.

deck-0178.jpg.title: Karrouhat
deck-0178.jpg.bio: A DJ, singer, songwriter, composer, filmmaker and creative director who studied at the New York Film Academy, Karrouhat grew up across the Arab world and loves 90s culture and classic Arabic music. His sets are a nostalgic tribute to his culture and childhood, blending Arabic favourites in a fresh way that audiences love.

deck-0179.jpg.title: Hilde
deck-0179.jpg.bio: A Brazilian DJ and producer, Hilde has played clubs, lounges, beach clubs, private events and yacht parties across Brazil, China, Hong Kong, Indonesia, Oman, Saudi Arabia and the UAE. Her own releases include Me Quer Bem on Lekkerecord and Forgotten Dreams, and her sets bring sunshine and great energy to any party.

deck-0180.jpg.title: Dagari
deck-0180.jpg.bio: A British-Iranian DJ from London, DAGARI blends traditional Middle Eastern samples and vocals with contemporary Western sounds. Moving across the house spectrum with Afro, Latin and Mediterranean influences, his sets are rich, unique and captivating, perfect for stylish venues and events with a global crowd.

deck-0181.jpg.title: Michelle
deck-0181.jpg.bio: A pioneer of the Future Rave genre in China, Michelle crafts anthemic melodies and driving bass lines that take audiences on a journey. She has toured with DJ Mag Top 100 artists Mike Williams and Fedde Le Grand and appeared at shows headlined by Taylor Swift and Katy Perry, giving her all to crowds of every size.

deck-0182.jpg.title: Mixada
deck-0182.jpg.bio: With over eight years behind the decks in Lebanon and the UAE, Mixada knows how to engage a crowd. After honing his skills at Dalida Bar in Lebanon, he moved to Dubai in 2022 as DJ coordinator at Sheraton JBR and has since played venues including Above Rooftop, Balcon Beach Lounge and Olympo Rooftop.

deck-0183.jpg.title: Alicia
deck-0183.jpg.bio: An open-format DJ who has played across the UK, Europe and Dubai, Alicia mixes 80s disco, 90s R&B, house, hip-hop and club classics with today's hits. With residencies at top London and international venues including W Hotel and STK London, her high-energy sets keep dance floors packed day or night.

deck-0184.jpg.title: Joe
deck-0184.jpg.bio: After five years playing top UK clubs and touring as DJ for the Love Island winners' tour in 2017, Joe now holds residencies across Dubai. Specialising in R&B, hip-hop and house but happy to switch to any genre, he keeps his selections open and always plays to the crowd.

deck-0185.jpg.title: Koshka
deck-0185.jpg.bio: Originally from Uzbekistan and based in the UAE for 12 years, Koshka has played some of Dubai's most exclusive venues. An open-format DJ with a passion for organic, Afro and soulful house, she reads a crowd brilliantly and delivers dynamic, energetic sets.

deck-0186.jpg.title: Major Flow
deck-0186.jpg.bio: Born in Lebanon, Major Flow started DJing on a dual tape deck and has been rocking crowds since 2002. Specialising in reggaeton, hip-hop, R&B and dancehall, he has played nightclubs, lounges and pool parties in the USA, Lebanon, the Philippines, Hong Kong, Egypt, Qatar, Oman, Bahrain, the Maldives and the UAE.

deck-0187.jpg.title: Mike D
deck-0187.jpg.bio: Mike D began his career at 16 on Beirut radio, building skills in sound, DJing and production with leading Lebanese stations and clubs. In the UAE since 2007, he joined Fujairah Media Group as producer and DJ and has played many of the country's best-known clubs and lounges.

deck-0188.jpg.title: Tarek
deck-0188.jpg.bio: An open-format DJ known for a dynamic blend of Arabic music, hip-hop and R&B, Tarek fuses traditional sounds with contemporary beats. His energetic performances and vibrant playlists connect with diverse audiences, making him a sought-after choice for parties, weddings and nightlife.

deck-0189.jpg.title: Zee
deck-0189.jpg.bio: An open-format DJ since 2012, Zee is known for his English-Arabic fusion mixes and has performed alongside well-known names. He plays hip-hop, R&B, commercial, Latin, Afrobeats, EDM, deep house and Arabic, and his SoundCloud mixes have hundreds of thousands of plays.

deck-0190.jpg.title: RB
deck-0190.jpg.bio: A professional club DJ and producer since 2010, RB is equally at home as a resident or event DJ, playing clubs, hotels, yacht, rooftop and beach parties and concerts. His residencies include Mykonos Lounge, The Village at Le Meridien, ONYX and Moksh at Conrad Etihad Towers in Abu Dhabi.

deck-0191.jpg.title: Elena
deck-0191.jpg.bio: An energetic Dubai-based DJ passionate about art, film, photography and fashion, Elena has played the Abu Dhabi F1 Grand Prix, Fashion Forward Dubai and an OK! Magazine showcase. She has held residencies at Mandarin Oriental, Atlantis The Palm, Burj Al Arab and SLS Dubai.

deck-0192.jpg.title: Danny
deck-0192.jpg.bio: Danny's love of music spans four decades, from soul, funk and rare groove to hip-hop, jazz funk, disco and soulful house. Originally from London, he ran the Mixmag-acclaimed club night Open Wide in Leeds and since 2012 has held residencies at 360 Dubai, bringing deep musical knowledge to every set.

deck-0193.jpg.title: Nicki
deck-0193.jpg.bio: Originally from Queens, New York, and in the UAE for over a decade, Nicki has held residencies at five-star venues in Abu Dhabi and Dubai. She has headlined Dubai Shopping Festival and the All Africa Festival at Burj Park, performing with Dave, Shenseea and Rema, and moves seamlessly from hip-hop to Afrobeats.

deck-0194.jpg.title: Stu
deck-0194.jpg.bio: A DJ and producer with 17 years of experience, Stu has held residencies in the UK, Dubai, Australia, Spain and Switzerland, played alongside Glitterbox and Defected DJs and supported Dua Lipa. He has performed at private events for celebrities including Kris Jenner and Selena Gomez, and his music has topped the Beatport charts.

deck-0195.jpg.title: Fatima
deck-0195.jpg.bio: Originally from Azerbaijan and DJing since 16, Fatima has over a decade of experience and a love of electronic music. She has performed at Jumeirah Beach Hotel, V Hotel Al Habtoor City, Mandarin Oriental and Burj Al Arab, bringing passion and polish to luxury events and venues.

deck-0196.jpg.title: Ema
deck-0196.jpg.bio: A DJ from Manchester known for uplifting vocal house and tech house, E.M.A has held Dubai residencies at Sparkle and Club Tropicana. She has opened for Rudimental at BCM Mallorca, played The Warehouse Project and the Abu Dhabi F1, and was an official DJ for Coca-Cola's World Cup activity in the Middle East.

deck-0197.jpg.title: Sara G
deck-0197.jpg.bio: A Dubai-based DJ and emcee, Sara plays hip-hop, commercial, deep house and EDM. A former anchor for CNN for five years, she brings genuine presenting skills alongside her music, making her a great two-in-one choice for brand events, parties and corporate occasions.

deck-0198.jpg.title: Julia P.
deck-0198.jpg.bio: A DJ and producer with over ten years of experience, Julia creates atmospheres that keep guests engaged. She has played the Abu Dhabi F1 Grand Prix, Fashion Forward Dubai and events for Harvey Nichols and Dolce & Gabbana, and has released music on labels including Pukka Up Ibiza.

deck-0199.jpg.title: Alena
deck-0199.jpg.bio: Originally from Belarus and DJing since 2016, Alena trained in piano, voice and dance from a young age and graduated top of her country's leading DJ school. In Dubai she has played prominent venues including Fluid at Th8 Palm Jumeirah, bringing musicality and energy to clubs, lounges and beach events.

deck-0200.jpg.title: J'Adora
deck-0200.jpg.bio: A fresh international DJ based in Dubai, J'Adora plays house, tech house, R&B, hip-hop, Afrobeats, amapiano, soul, disco and commercial dance. She has performed across the UK and internationally at clubs, launches, boat parties and corporate events, including the Abu Dhabi F1 Grand Prix.

deck-0201.jpg.title: Naz
deck-0201.jpg.bio: An international open-format DJ with over 15 years of experience, Naz began his career in Finland and has toured 13 countries across Europe, Africa and the Middle East. He has shared stages with Snoop Dogg, DMX and Missy Elliott and played top Dubai venues including VII and Dark Room.

deck-0202.jpg.title: Joy
deck-0202.jpg.bio: An open-format DJ from the south of France, Joy made his radio debut at 16 and went on to play Marseille's biggest clubs. He has performed at Nikki Beach Saint-Tropez, for Hed Kandi, at Life Club Monaco and at FIVE Palm Jumeirah, bringing French flair and great energy to every set.

deck-0203.jpg.title: Tala
deck-0203.jpg.bio: Born in Chicago and raised in Dubai, Tala is one of the region's original It Girls and a fast-rising name on the Middle East DJ circuit. A violinist growing up, she was inspired by vinyl collections and friends in the industry, and her fresh sets work off the vibe of the crowd.

deck-0204.jpg.title: Kat
deck-0204.jpg.bio: Originally from Moscow, Kat took to the stage at seven and became a ballroom champion before discovering her talent for DJing in Dubai. Her love of house, Latin and R&B shines through in sets full of rhythm, movement and fun.

deck-0205.jpg.title: Karine
deck-0205.jpg.bio: A Lebanese DJ based in Dubai, Karine started mixing in 2020 at Karnaval, her own series of private all-night parties. Her style is anything that sounds good, from nu-disco and house to Afro and organic house, and she makes sure everyone has as much fun on the dance floor as she does behind the decks.

deck-0207.jpg.title: Canella Duo / Trio
deck-0207.jpg.bio: Led by classically trained harpist Lidia, originally from Bulgaria and based in Dubai since 2005, Canella performs as a duo of harp with flute or violin, or as a trio of all three. Lidia's love of Arabic culture means the repertoire includes beautiful arrangements of well-known Arabic songs alongside classical and modern pieces.

deck-0208.jpg.title: Harp Duo
deck-0208.jpg.bio: The Harp Duo brings together two of the region's most accomplished harpists, Lidia and Diana, both originally from Bulgaria. Lidia weaves well-known Arabic songs into her repertoire, while Diana, honoured as a UNESCO Messenger of Peace, has been resident harpist at Burj Al Arab since 2011. Together they create a truly magical sound.

deck-0209.jpg.title: Piano and Violin Duo
deck-0209.jpg.bio: Kristina and Giselle deliver a captivating mix of classical and contemporary music on piano and violin. Kristina began violin and piano at seven and has won numerous awards, while Giselle, a Moscow Conservatory graduate, has performed at prestigious events including Cartier's event on the Burj Al Arab helipad.

deck-0210.jpg.title: Classical Trio
deck-0210.jpg.bio: Led by violinist Kristina, who performed in a violin duo for 11 years before moving to the UAE in 2016, this trio of violin, harp and cello offers a rich, harmonious sound. They have played royal weddings, festivals and events, blending classical and contemporary repertoire with elegance.

deck-0211.jpg.title: Classical Trio
deck-0211.jpg.bio: Led by violinist Kristina, this elegant ensemble can perform as a violin and harp duo or a trio with cello. Since moving to the UAE in 2016, Kristina has performed at royal weddings, festivals and events, blending classical and contemporary music into enchanting performances.

deck-0212.jpg.title: Giulia and Kristina
deck-0212.jpg.bio: Italian cellist Giulia brings over 14 years of conservatory-trained experience in classical, Arabic and contemporary music, performing at Dubai Opera, Expo 2020 and the opening of the Museum of the Future. With violinist Kristina, a soloist and duo performer for many years, they create an elegant string sound for weddings and events.

deck-0213.jpg.title: Saxophone and Violin Duo
deck-0213.jpg.bio: Kristina and Pasha form a captivating saxophone and violin duo.
