Kristina has played corporate events, exhibitions, fashion shows and weddings in Dubai for over six years, while Pasha is celebrated for performances at royal ceremonies, global award shows and Khaliji weddings with unique takes on traditional songs.

deck-0214.jpg.title: Soprano Trio
deck-0214.jpg.bio: Three talented sopranos singing in perfect harmony, the Soprano Trio performs operatic classics, crossover hits, movie themes and barbershop arrangements. Powerful, polished and beautifully synchronised, they bring grandeur and charm to galas, weddings, festive events and receptions.

deck-0215.jpg.title: Gulf String Quartet
deck-0215.jpg.bio: Formed in 2019 by four leading musicians from the UAE music community, the Gulf String Quartet has performed with Katherine Jenkins, Emel Mathlouthi and Phantom of the Opera at Dubai Opera, and is resident quartet for Candlelight concerts across the UAE. A superb choice for ceremonies, galas and prestigious events.

deck-0216.jpg.title: Jose Jazz Trio
deck-0216.jpg.bio: Led by pianist, trombonist and composer Jose, this acclaimed jazz trio specialises in Latin-Arabic fusion mixed with classical and Afro-Cuban influences. Jose has performed at top international festivals, and the band's intricate rhythms and melodic lines create a dynamic, innovative and engaging musical experience.

deck-0217.jpg.title: Rudo Jazz Trio
deck-0217.jpg.bio: A pop-jazz trio created by three-time SAMA Award-nominated arranger and composer Rudo on upright bass and vocals, with Joel on piano and Janelle on drums. They have shared stages with John Legend, Alicia Keys and Gregory Porter and opened for Beyoncé. Their foot-tapping jazz reinventions of five decades of hits make for a fun, fresh evening.

deck-0219.jpg.title: Sandra
deck-0219.jpg.bio: Playing piano since the age of seven, Sandra graduated in piano from the National Conservatory of Music in Bulgaria and has performed as a soloist, with orchestra and in bands. She loves creating her own arrangements, putting a personal touch on pop songs, Arabic music and classical pieces alike.

deck-0220.jpg.title: Anna S.
deck-0220.jpg.bio: A pianist from St Petersburg, Anna studied piano at music school and college, took masterclasses with acclaimed Polish pianist Leszek Możdżer and studied pop music at the St Petersburg State Institute of Culture. Her versatile playing suits elegant receptions, dinners and luxury events.

deck-0221.jpg.title: Giselle
deck-0221.jpg.bio: An internationally renowned pianist and Moscow Conservatory graduate, Giselle has won an international piano competition in France and performs at VIP events and special projects, including Cartier's event on the Burj Al Arab helipad in 2021. Elegant, refined and deeply musical.

deck-0222.jpg.title: Stoyan
deck-0222.jpg.bio: A music producer, composer and conductor with over 20 years of experience, Stoyan trained at a professional music school and conservatory. He has collaborated with many artists and loves orchestrating live performances, bringing a rich, symphonic sensibility to every event he plays.

deck-0224.jpg.title: Aksinia
deck-0224.jpg.bio: An acclaimed saxophonist, Aksinia has performed at events for Coca-Cola, Dubai Fashion Week and Formula 1 in Abu Dhabi, and alongside stars including Lionel Richie, Seal and Alicia Keys. A seasoned performer who has appeared on prime-time television, she brings glamour, energy and polish to every stage.

deck-0225.jpg.title: Kristina
deck-0225.jpg.bio: One of Dubai's most soulful saxophonists, Kristina has over five years of experience at corporate events, presentations, exhibitions, fashion shows, weddings and private parties, often alongside DJs and artists. She has played venues including Conrad's Puro Beach, Iris at The Oberoi, ShoCho and Abu Dhabi Golf Club.

deck-0226.jpg.title: Matt
deck-0226.jpg.bio: A saxophonist, multi-instrumentalist and DJ from Los Angeles, Matt studied at Juilliard and The New School in New York and has performed in over 50 countries at some of the world's finest venues. Combining live sax with DJ sets, he is a brilliant all-in-one choice for parties, brunches and luxury events.

deck-0227.jpg.title: May R.
deck-0227.jpg.bio: A Cuban saxophonist and graduate of the José White Conservatory with ten years of experience, May has performed in Bahrain, Vietnam and across the UAE at hotels including Emirates Palace, Mandarin Oriental, Raffles The Palm, The Ritz-Carlton and Four Seasons. Her repertoire spans pop, romantic music, jazz and bossa nova.

deck-0228.jpg.title: Dave
deck-0228.jpg.bio: A world-class saxophonist and producer, Dave has collaborated with leading DJs including Milk & Sugar, Plastik Funk and Sean Finn, and his productions have played on top European radio stations. With DJ Pesho he forms the producer duo Pesho & Dave Bo, releasing on Kontor Records. Live sax with real club credentials.

deck-0229.jpg.title: Manuel
deck-0229.jpg.bio: A Colombian saxophonist who began at the Colombian Conservatory of Music, Manuel plays jazz, chill-out, classical and Latin, and has also sung lead with bands and a classical choir. In Dubai for over eight years, he is now fusing house music with live sax for a fresh, modern sound.

deck-0230.jpg.title: Aleksandra D.
deck-0230.jpg.bio: Originally from Poland and in Dubai for over five years, Aleksandra trained in music from a young age and spent eight years with the Ensemble band, collaborating with guitarists, vocalists, pianists and dancers. She launched her UAE career in 2014 and brings versatile, polished performances to every event.

deck-0231.jpg.title: Marin
deck-0231.jpg.bio: MarciSax has been based in Dubai since 2003, performing at luxury five-star venues with DJs and musicians across Dubai and Abu Dhabi. Holding a Master's in pop and jazz saxophone from Sofia, he plays pop, smooth jazz, nu-disco, soulful, deep and tech house, and is a favourite for high-profile events, corporate gigs and weddings.

deck-0232.jpg.title: Maby
deck-0232.jpg.bio: A Cuban saxophonist based in Abu Dhabi, Maby trained in choral singing and saxophone and played classical music with the Provincial Concert Band in Havana before moving into Latin bands. A former music teacher, she brings warmth, technique and Latin flair to hotels, events and celebrations.

deck-0233.jpg.title: Christian
deck-0233.jpg.bio: A Colombian saxophonist and University of Antioquia graduate, Christian is known for his distinctive sound and improvisation. With over ten years of experience across Latin America, France and Germany, he now performs at some of the UAE's finest hotels, restaurants and luxury private events.

deck-0234.jpg.title: Karolina
deck-0234.jpg.bio: A saxophonist and multi-instrumentalist performing since 2010, Karolina has won Russian and international competitions and toured Russia, Belarus, Spain and Qatar. Based in Dubai, she collaborates with DJs and musicians, improvising live over deep, organic and Latin house, disco and funk.

deck-0235.jpg.title: Dan B.
deck-0235.jpg.bio: A contestant on Sweden's Got Talent in 2021, Dan has performed everywhere from royal gatherings in the South of France to VIP clubs in Scandinavia. Regularly booked for weddings, corporate events, venue openings and festivals, his credits include Nikki Beach in Barbados and Dubai and Aura Skypool.

deck-0237.jpg.title: Malena
deck-0237.jpg.bio: Born in Cuba, Malena is a versatile flutist whose range spans classical music to traditional Arabic sounds and everything in between. Comfortable with acoustic, Arabic, Latin and chill-out styles and backing tracks, she blends genres in a way that makes her performances unique and memorable.

deck-0238.jpg.title: Darya
deck-0238.jpg.bio: An accomplished flutist and educator with over 16 years of experience, Darya holds a Master's from the Lviv National Music Academy and won first place at Ukraine's National Competition for Wind Instruments. She has performed at Dubai Opera, Formula 1 and the Dubai World Cup, plus festivals across the Middle East.

deck-0239.jpg.title: Tania
deck-0239.jpg.bio: A Colombian musician who studied at a leading university and played with orchestras, wind bands and a renowned reggae band, Tania has developed her own style playing well-known songs instrumentally. In the UAE she has performed at top Abu Dhabi hotels, weddings, festivals and Dubai Opera with the Felicity Orchestra.

deck-0241.jpg.title: Mikey
deck-0241.jpg.bio: Based in Dubai since 2010, Mikey founded the party band BIG Mouth in 2017, with a repertoire of over 450 songs spanning 70 years of popular music. The band has held residencies at Hard Rock Cafe and Caesars Palace and played the Dubai Rugby 7s, Formula 1 and the opening of The Pointe fountain.

deck-0242.jpg.title: Daniel
deck-0242.jpg.bio: From a musical family, Daniel began singing and playing guitar at 12, attended stage school and earned a BA in Popular Music from the University of Gloucestershire. He has performed at everything from intimate gigs and weddings to corporate events and festivals in England, and now brings that experience to Dubai.

deck-0243.jpg.title: Andre
deck-0243.jpg.bio: A South African guitarist and singer, Andre builds dynamic live loops with acoustic guitar, percussion, harmonica and effects to accompany his polished vocals. In Dubai since 2015, he has held long-term residencies at prestigious five-star venues and is a sought-after choice for hotels, brunches and private events.

deck-0244.jpg.title: Dan M.
deck-0244.jpg.bio: A multi-talented Dubai-based musician, Dan blends acoustic guitar with innovative live looping to create a wide range of moods, from relaxed afternoon vibes to full party energy. He has held weekly residencies and performed at top venues including Time Out Market, Emirates Palace, Jumeirah Beach Hotel and Expo 2020, making him a trusted choice for hotels, brunches and private events.

deck-0245.jpg.title: Aston
deck-0245.jpg.bio: A South African multi-instrumentalist and singer-songwriter, Aston found fame on The Voice South Africa and is celebrated for his energetic live shows and clever looping, layering classic and modern hits into unique new versions. His mix of musicianship and entertainment makes every set a memorable, one-man-band experience.

deck-0246.jpg.title: Vicente
deck-0246.jpg.bio: A Chilean guitarist, composer and author, Vicente trained in flamenco guitar and blends it with bolero, ballads, bossa nova and Italian popular music. He has released his own album and performed in Santiago, Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Moscow, Muscat, Amsterdam, Paris, Madrid, Beirut and Doha.

deck-0248.jpg.title: Daneel
deck-0248.jpg.bio: An innovative percussionist and finalist on Arabs Got Talent, Daneel performed at the Music Hall Theatre for five years, at the London Olympics and on the Stars on Board tour across Europe. A regular at major Middle East festivals, he is also a hands-on artistic director who brings real creativity to every show.

deck-0249.jpg.title: Inas
deck-0249.jpg.bio: The first Syrian female drummer and percussionist, Inas has broken barriers in a male-dominated field since 2007. She inherited her passion from her late father, Syria's first officially registered drummer, who performed with Fairouz and the Rahbani Brothers. A powerful, inspiring performer for any stage.

deck-0250.jpg.title: Miti
deck-0250.jpg.bio: A Cuban percussionist known as Miti, he holds a Bachelor of Music from the Higher Institute of Arts in Havana and has years of experience teaching symphonic percussion. He brings authentic Cuban rhythm and serious musicianship to live sets with DJs, bands and Latin-themed events.

deck-0251.jpg.title: Pascale
deck-0251.jpg.bio: A Lebanese percussionist based in Dubai, Pascale is known for a unique fusion of oriental and occidental percussion. She performed with bands throughout her studies in Beirut and joined the Firdaus Orchestra in 2021, and is one of the region's most sought-after percussionists.

deck-0252.jpg.title: Fernando
deck-0252.jpg.bio: An international percussionist based in the UAE with Bachelor's and Master's degrees from Spain and Bulgaria, Fernando has won top honours in national and international competitions. He brings dynamic flair to festivals, weddings, parties and corporate events, and pairs brilliantly with DJs.

deck-0253.jpg.title: Morsi
deck-0253.jpg.bio: Performing in orchestras, bands and theatre since 2013, Morsi is percussionist with the Andalusia Spanish band and founder of the Egyptian and Khaleeji music group Mazag. He has played with stars including Rami Ayach, Mohamed Nour, Balqees and Abdullah Ruwaished at festivals inside and outside Egypt.

deck-0254.jpg.title: Boudi
deck-0254.jpg.bio: Known as Boudi, he is a percussionist, dancer, entertainer and circus acrobat who began performing at 16 and honed his skills in Beirut. Combining rhythm, movement and showmanship, he brings high-energy entertainment to parties, festivals and events across the region.

deck-0256.jpg.title: Giulia
deck-0256.jpg.bio: An accomplished Italian cellist with over 14 years of experience, Giulia is conservatory-trained and plays everything from classical to Arabic and contemporary music on acoustic and electric cello. She has performed at Dubai Opera, Expo 2020 and the opening of the Museum of the Future, and has collaborated with cellist HAUSER.

deck-0257.jpg.title: Stina
deck-0257.jpg.bio: Known as Stina, Kristina is a dynamic cellist who plays both modern electric and classical acoustic cello. With strong musical training, international competition awards and great improvisation skills, she has performed at luxury hotels, clubs and events including Formula 1 in Abu Dhabi.

deck-0258.jpg.title: Gulziya
deck-0258.jpg.bio: A cellist from Kazakhstan, Gulziya studied at the National Conservatory of Kazakhstan on a presidential scholarship and graduated from the Glinka Conservatory in Russia as a concert cellist and teacher. She has extensive orchestral and chamber experience and has won several international competitions.

deck-0260.jpg.title: Ulyana
deck-0260.jpg.bio: A virtuoso harpist performing since the age of five, Ulyana has been based in Dubai since 2014 and has played prestigious events including the Dubai World Cup. With a degree in harp performance and residencies at Address and Kempinski hotels, she performs modern, classical and Arabic music on a magnificent concert grand harp.

deck-0261.jpg.title: Lidia
deck-0261.jpg.bio: Originally from Bulgaria and based in Dubai since 2005, Lidia is a classically trained harpist who fell in love with Arabic culture and weaves well-known Arabic songs into her repertoire. She has shared the stage with Marwan Khoury and Charbel Rouhana and is one of the leading harpists in the region.

deck-0262.jpg.title: Diana
deck-0262.jpg.bio: A masterful harpist with a Master's from the National Academy of Music in Bulgaria, Diana has performed in Switzerland, Austria, Norway, Kuwait and South Korea. Honoured as a UNESCO Messenger of Peace and resident harpist at Burj Al Arab since 2011, her emotive, sophisticated playing is pure elegance.

deck-0264.jpg.title: Julio
deck-0264.jpg.bio: One of the foremost live performers in dance music, Julio is also a producer, arranger and composer who began his career in Cuba at seven. He has shared stages with industry giants and played over 70 shows in 40 cities in a single year, blending acoustic and electronic music into powerful, dynamic performances.

deck-0265.jpg.title: Kristina B.
deck-0265.jpg.bio: Kristina began violin and piano at seven, winning awards across Russia, and studied violin at music college and university. After 11 years in a violin duo and as a soloist at events and weddings, she moved to the UAE in 2016 and now performs at royal weddings, festivals and events.

deck-0266.jpg.title: Maria
deck-0266.jpg.bio: A violinist from Belarus, Maria began her career with the Molodechno Symphony Orchestra and has performed internationally since 2015, from India and Indonesia to Turkey. In the UAE she has played prestigious venues including Rixos Bab Al Bahr, Anantara Abu Dhabi and JA The Resort.

deck-0267.jpg.title: Pasha
deck-0267.jpg.bio: A Dubai-based violinist with over a decade of experience across the Middle East, Pasha plays classical, pop, Arabic, jazz, deep house and Khaliji music on electric and acoustic violin. She is sought after for royal ceremonies, global award shows and corporate events, and is a favourite at Khaliji weddings.

deck-0268.jpg.title: Tijana
deck-0268.jpg.bio: Tijana holds Bachelor's and Master's degrees in violin from the University of Arts in Belgrade and has won over 30 prizes. She has performed at Tartini Hall in Italy and Milan Conservatory, and in the UAE at Expo, Dubai Opera, Abu Dhabi Cultural Foundation, ULTRA Abu Dhabi and Etihad Museum.

deck-0269.jpg.title: Becky
deck-0269.jpg.bio: Becky studied music at Cambridge University and earned a Master's in viola performance at the Royal College of Music in London. She has worked with the Philharmonia, BBC Symphony Orchestra and Royal Opera House, and since 2012 has performed in the UAE with international orchestras and at private events.

deck-0270.jpg.title: Marta
deck-0270.jpg.bio: A classically trained violinist from Poland with a Master's in music, Marta has performed across Europe, China and on cruise ships. Since 2015 she has played high-profile events in the UAE including Formula 1, the Dubai World Cup and the Dubai Duty Free Tennis Championships.

deck-0271.jpg.title: Anna
deck-0271.jpg.bio: After a classical career that included performing with the Vienna Philharmonic, Anna moved to the Middle East as resident musician at Burj Al Arab. One of Dubai's most popular violinists, she captivates audiences with her vibrant personality and versatile classical, lounge and pop performances.

deck-0272.jpg.title: Dalia
deck-0272.jpg.bio: A skilled violinist with solo and ensemble experience, Dalia has performed at Yas Waterworld, Ferrari World, Warner Bros. World Abu Dhabi, Emirates Palace and InterContinental Abu Dhabi. She brings elegance and energy to brunches, hotel events and celebrations.

deck-0273.jpg.title: Sana
deck-0273.jpg.bio: An Abu Dhabi-based violinist and graduate of the Kyrgyzstan National Musical College, Sana blends Western pop with Arabic and oriental influences and excels in Khaleeji, classical and pop. A Delphic Games finalist, she has played Jumeirah Beach Hotel, Emirates Palace Mandarin Oriental and Four Seasons.

deck-0274.jpg.title: Violin Trio
deck-0274.jpg.bio: Led by violinist Marta, who began performing with the Youth Orchestra in Hungary at 14 and played under conductors including Trevor Pinnock, this violin trio brings orchestral polish and beautiful harmony to weddings, receptions and gala events.

deck-0275.jpg.title: Naima
deck-0275.jpg.bio: A Cuban violinist based in Dubai, Naima holds a degree in music performance and education and has performed with Joshua Bell, Wynton Marsalis and Yo-Yo Ma. She has toured with the Havana Lyceum Orchestra and played Carnegie Hall and Boston Opera House, across classical, jazz, soul and pop.

deck-0276.jpg.title: Ana
deck-0276.jpg.bio: A violinist with two decades of experience, Ana-Gabriela weaves magic across pop and Arabic music, performing at weddings, on theatre stages and at events. A dedicated teacher for over ten years, she brings passion and expression to every performance.

deck-0277.jpg.title: Jessi
deck-0277.jpg.bio: From Santiago de Cuba, Jessi played violin with the Esteban Salas Camerata, Ad Libitum String Orchestra and Oriente Symphony Orchestra. In Bahrain she performed as pianist, violinist and vocalist with the Vibes Trio at Bushido, and she now brings her multi-talented Latin flair to the UAE.

deck-0279.jpg.title: Samah
deck-0279.jpg.bio: An art therapy practitioner, handpan teacher and sound healing guide, Samah creates captivating handpan performances that transport listeners. Her calming, meditative sound is perfect for wellness events, desert evenings, spa launches and relaxed, atmospheric gatherings.

deck-0280.jpg.title: Kdun
deck-0280.jpg.bio: Originally from Jordan and educated in the US, Kdun is a Dubai-based composer and self-taught drummer who fell in love with the handpan. He uses its hypnotic, bell-like tones to play popular melodies in a fresh and harmonious way, creating a unique vibe at any event.

deck-0282.jpg.title: Olga
deck-0282.jpg.bio: A handpan master and teacher who practises sound therapy, Olga has performed at music festivals in several countries. Her playing brings harmony and calm to any setting, ideal for wellness events, desert dinners and serene, atmospheric occasions.

deck-0283.jpg.title: Nawar
deck-0283.jpg.bio: Nawar began singing at five and studied piano and guitar before discovering the handpan in 2018, learning under the Middle East's first handpan player. From 2019 to 2023 she was a key member of a Dubai handpan ensemble, and she now brings her soothing, magical sound to events of every kind.

deck-0284.jpg.title: Handpan Ensemble
deck-0284.jpg.bio: An ensemble of up to five male and female handpan musicians, creating a captivating, ethereal atmosphere. Their harmonious melodies are especially magical in desert settings, where the open landscape enhances the mystical, serene sound. A deeply immersive experience for desert camps, wellness events and sunset gatherings.

deck-0286.jpg.title: Hosny
deck-0286.jpg.bio: An oud player and Arabic singer, Mohamed studied at the Conservatoire de Musique in Alexandria and the Arabic Oud House under masters including Naseer Shamma. He has performed at the Bibliotheca Alexandrina and Cairo Jazz Club, and has been based in the UAE since 2015.

deck-0287.jpg.title: Benna Solo / Duo
deck-0287.jpg.bio: An oud player, composer and singer, Nina has performed at major international and regional festivals, opened for renowned artists and played for heads of state. With composing experience across the region and Europe, she brings depth and soul to cultural events and elegant evenings.

deck-0288.jpg.title: Oula
deck-0288.jpg.bio: A graduate of the FFA High Music Institute, Oula has been performing since 2019 at venues including Dubai Opera during Ramadan, the Louvre Abu Dhabi and Amazon's Suhoor in Dubai, as well as Ferrari events, weddings and private gatherings. Versatile and graceful, she brings beautiful oud music to any occasion.

deck-0289.jpg.title: Sedra
deck-0289.jpg.bio: A professional oud player with ten years of experience, Sedra delivers passionate performances that resonate deeply with audiences. A respected music teacher who has performed in concert halls and on many stages, she brings real artistry to cultural events, Ramadan gatherings and elegant dinners.

deck-0290.jpg.title: Farnoush
deck-0290.jpg.bio: A distinguished oud player with a varied career, Farnoush spent eight years as producer, presenter and expert on a music programme on Radio Farhang. She has performed at celebrations in Iran and festivals in Austria and the Czech Republic, bringing rich Persian and Arabic repertoire to every event.

deck-0291.jpg.title: Tina
deck-0291.jpg.bio: An oud player and composer with Bachelor's and Master's degrees in Iranian music from Tehran University of Art, Tina has played professionally since 2004. Her album Speak With No Letters is available on all digital platforms, and she has performed at prestigious venues inside and outside Iran.

deck-0293.jpg.title: Nagham
deck-0293.jpg.bio: Dubai's first female qanun player, Nagham is originally from Syria and has made Dubai her home for many years. With her brothers Basel and Zaid she forms the Debal Band, and as a composer, singer and qanun player she has performed at festivals across the Middle East and the UAE.

deck-0294.jpg.title: Areej
deck-0294.jpg.bio: A qanun player trained at the Fujairah Academy of Fine Arts, where she received a certificate of honour, Areej has performed at major concerts in the UAE's Eastern Region, including the Oud and Jazz concert led by maestro Arturo O'Farrill, and at many cultural and national events.

deck-0295.jpg.title: Nazgol
deck-0295.jpg.bio: An award-winning qanun player based in Dubai, Nazgol plays Arabic, classical, traditional, oriental house and fusion music. She has performed in Iran, the UAE, Turkey, Sweden, Norway, Jordan, Bahrain and Egypt, and at high-profile events including Expo 2020 and the Fashion Awards.

deck-0296.jpg.title: Bella
deck-0296.jpg.bio: Born in Armenia into a family of musicians, Bella began studying at six and won a Grand Prix representing her country at international folk festivals. She moved to the UAE after university, started out at Dubai Opera and since 2019 has performed at government events and celebrations across the Emirates.

deck-0298.jpg.title: Mind2Mind
deck-0298.jpg.bio: More than a show, Mind2Mind is an immersive journey through mentalism and magic. James and Marina are a world-class Dubai magician duo with an inclusive, interactive style that makes every audience member part of the experience. Perfect for corporate events, gala dinners and VIP gatherings.

deck-0299.jpg.title: Ash Rose
deck-0299.jpg.bio: Originally from South Wales and now based in Dubai, Ash is a stand-up and roaming magician who has entertained audiences in over 18 countries. His blend of comedy and magic, and his perfect timing in approaching groups, make his magic a highlight of any event without ever interrupting it.

deck-0300.jpg.title: Felipe
deck-0300.jpg.bio: With over 21 years of experience, Felipe is a close-up magician who has performed for celebrities, presidents and royal families and at five-star hotels worldwide. Known as the man who dazzles the stars, his humour, charisma and easy-going style leave guests amused, bemused and talking all night.

deck-0301.jpg.title: James Fabulous
deck-0301.jpg.bio: A magician and mentalist, James combines magic, psychology and mind reading to create moments of pure wonder, from revealing star signs and birthdays to the names of friends guests are thinking of. Charismatic and astonishing, he is perfect for corporate events, VIP dinners and private parties.

deck-0302.jpg.title: Alister
deck-0302.jpg.bio: A Dubai-based children's entertainer with over 20 years of experience, Alister performs a very, very silly comedy magic show that has kids and parents laughing. Having entertained at birthdays, community and corporate events in the UK, he now performs at the UAE's best hotels and biggest malls.

deck-0303.jpg.title: Helios
deck-0303.jpg.bio: Helios began performing magic at eight and won his first major prize at the International Magic Congress in Austria at 15. He became the youngest magician to perform on a cruise ship and is known as a daredevil of stage illusions, amazing audiences from Dubai to England and on television.

deck-0304.jpg.title: Ren
deck-0304.jpg.bio: A fun, friendly children's entertainer, Ren brings joy to kids of all ages with magic tricks, bubble displays, balloon animals, puppet shows and games. His interactive activities keep young guests excited and engaged, making him a great choice for birthday parties and family events.

deck-0306.jpg.title: Eliza
deck-0306.jpg.bio: A renowned fashion and event illustrator based in Dubai, Eliza trained in graphic arts and blends digital technology with traditional markers, pencils and watercolours. Her live illustrations make beautiful keepsakes for guests at weddings, brand launches and luxury events.

deck-0307.jpg.title: Diana
deck-0307.jpg.bio: A successful Dubai-based fashion and event illustrator, Diana creates digital illustrations alongside work in professional markers, pencils and watercolours. Her clients include luxury, fashion, beauty and jewellery brands, and her live sketches are a stylish highlight at any event.

deck-0308.jpg.title: Shayma
deck-0308.jpg.bio: A sand artist who rose to fame as a finalist on Arabs Got Talent, Shayma has captivated audiences worldwide and created work for TV adverts, Outlandish music videos and series theme songs. She pioneered children's programmes on Al Jazeera and has been a four-time ambassador for watch brand GC.

deck-0309.jpg.title: Ghyath
deck-0309.jpg.bio: A speed painter known for theatrical live art, Ghyath creates stunning paintings on stage in minutes, from portraits of any size to bespoke images. His techniques include inverted painting, glitter, light drawing, splash paint, UV art, shadow and puzzle painting, making for a jaw-dropping show.

deck-0401.jpg.title: Tailored Classical Musicians
deck-0401.jpg.bio: Elegant live classical music, tailored to your occasion. Our cellists, harpists, flutists and pianists are experienced performers who bring warmth and refinement to every setting, from the rich tones of the cello and the delicate shimmer of the harp to graceful flute melodies and a wide-ranging piano repertoire. Book them as soloists or together as an ensemble for weddings, corporate events and private celebrations across the UAE.

deck-0402.jpg.title: Giant Violinist
deck-0402.jpg.bio: Music meets spectacle. Towering above the crowd in a dramatic flowing gown, our giant violinist plays live as she glides through your event, creating a showstopping moment your guests will reach for their phones to capture. Perfect for grand entrances, red carpets, gala dinners and desert or beach settings, she can be styled to match your theme and colours. Pair her with our aerial and bubble musicians for a truly unforgettable musical experience.

deck-0403.jpg.title: Roaming Champagne Skirt
deck-0403.jpg.bio: A glamorous welcome your guests won't forget. Our performer moves through the room in a spectacular skirt tiered with sparkling glasses of champagne, inviting guests to help themselves straight from her gown. It's an elegant, interactive way to serve welcome drinks and a guaranteed photo moment, ideal for gala receptions, weddings, launches and VIP parties. Glasses can be filled with champagne, mocktails or any drink of your choice.

deck-0404.jpg.title: Tailored Dancer Shows
deck-0404.jpg.bio: From elegant ballet and contemporary pieces to high-energy cabaret and themed productions, our dancer shows are created around your event. Choose a single showstopping routine or a full choreographed show, with costumes, music and styling designed to match your theme, colours and brand. Our professional dancers perform on stages, in ballrooms and outdoors across the UAE, bringing polish, drama and energy to galas, launches, weddings and celebrations of every size.

deck-0405.jpg.title: Modern African Dancers
deck-0405.jpg.bio: Pure energy on stage. Hailing from Uganda, this Afro dance crew fuses Afrobeat, hip-hop and contemporary African styles into explosive, crowd-pleasing performances. Known across the UAE for their sharp choreography, vibrant style and infectious rhythm, they have performed alongside top artists and are one of the region's most exciting dance crews. Perfect for festivals, corporate parties, launches and celebrations that need a burst of colour and movement.

deck-0406.jpg.title: Traditional African Dancers
deck-0406.jpg.bio: A joyful celebration of culture. These dancers from Uganda bring the rhythm, colour and storytelling of traditional African dance to your event, with authentic costumes, powerful drumming and dazzling footwork. Their performances are full of life and guaranteed to get guests clapping along. A wonderful choice for cultural evenings, national day celebrations, festivals, hotel events and themed parties across the UAE.

deck-0407.jpg.title: Tailored Choir
deck-0407.jpg.bio: A choir experience designed around your occasion. Whether it's a wedding, gala, corporate event or private celebration, we curate a choir performance to suit the atmosphere you want to create. With a versatile repertoire spanning classical pieces to contemporary hits, and the option to arrange your favourite songs, a choir adds a moving, personal touch that your guests will remember long after the last note.

deck-0408.jpg.title: Fire Artists
deck-0408.jpg.bio: Light up the night. Our fire artists are trained professionals who combine skill, artistry and safety to create breathtaking performances with fire hula hoops, staffs, poi, torches and fans. From a hypnotic solo act to a thrilling group show, every routine is choreographed to music for maximum impact. Ideal for beach events, desert camps, festivals, private parties and corporate evenings, with full attention to safety at every venue.

deck-0409.jpg.title: Acrobat Bird Cage
deck-0409.jpg.bio: An enchanting welcome for your guests. Inside a stunning golden birdcage, our acrobat performs a graceful sequence of fluid movements in and around the cage, dressed in a shimmering bird-inspired costume. She can be joined by elegantly styled hostesses in themed costumes who greet and guide guests with warmth and charm. A beautiful centrepiece for hotel lobbies, gala receptions, launches and luxury events.

deck-0410.jpg.title: Sway Pole
deck-0410.jpg.bio: A thrilling circus act that takes entertainment to new heights. Our specialist performers sway high above the crowd on a flexible pole, showcasing incredible strength, balance and flexibility in a performance that keeps every eye looking up. Costumes can be tailored to your theme and style. Each set lasts up to 15 minutes, with a minimum 20-minute break between sets, making it perfect for welcome receptions, outdoor events and festivals.

deck-0411.jpg.title: Acrobat In Frame
deck-0411.jpg.bio: Art comes to life. Suspended within an elegant golden frame, our acrobat performs breathtaking aerial movements that combine strength, flexibility and grace. Her fluid choreography creates a living work of art, a spellbinding blend of acrobatics and beauty that leaves guests in awe. A striking choice for gala dinners, art-themed events, hotel openings and luxury receptions, where it doubles as an unforgettable photo moment.

deck-0412.jpg.title: Mirror Ball Acrobat
deck-0412.jpg.bio: Dazzling from every angle. Our acrobat performs a series of breathtaking tricks on and around a giant mirror ball, catching the light and scattering it across the room in a stunning display. Every twist and turn seems to defy gravity, blending skill, elegance and sparkle. Perfect for disco and glamour themes, New Year's Eve, gala dinners and parties that deserve a showstopping highlight.

deck-0413.jpg.title: Roly Poly
deck-0413.jpg.bio: A mesmerising acrobatic act full of flexibility, balance and grace that keeps audiences on the edge of their seats. Booked as a four-minute stage act, or as a roaming meet-and-greet in one area for up to 15 minutes per set. A stage of around 6m x 6m on a flat, hard floor is ideal, smaller spaces can be discussed, and the equipment leaves no marks.

deck-0414.jpg.title: Alexandra
deck-0414.jpg.bio: An international master of ceremonies and panel moderator based in Dubai, Alexandra brings over two decades of experience hosting events across Europe, Africa and the Gulf, including COP28, LEAP, Black Hat, GITEX and the Global Cybersecurity Forum. Fluent in English and French with basic Arabic, she engages speakers and audiences with warmth and eloquence. A sought-after host for conferences, tech expos, award ceremonies, cultural festivals and diplomatic functions.

deck-0415.jpg.title: Rania
deck-0415.jpg.bio: A seasoned radio and TV senior presenter, Rania is known for her engaging presence and dynamic communication. As a respected speaker and emcee, she has hosted numerous high-profile events, bringing energy and professionalism to every stage. She is also a public speaking trainer and coach and a certified happiness coach, which shows in the warmth and confidence she brings to every audience. Ideal for corporate events, conferences, award nights and galas.

deck-0416.jpg.title: Jessy
deck-0416.jpg.bio: An emcee, certified media trainer and multilingual journalist, Jessy has spent over 18 years writing and presenting news for international outlets, including as a correspondent for the BBC and Sky News Arabia. She has led media projects for government and private clients across the GCC, and created and presented Sky News Arabia's first live TV social media programme. Fluent in English, Arabic and French, she is a polished choice for conferences, summits and corporate events.

deck-0417.jpg.title: Nuvo Soul
deck-0417.jpg.bio: Soulful, seductive and sublime. Shortlisted for Best Live Band at Time Out Dubai's Nightlife Awards in 2018 and 2022 and named Abu Dhabi's best band in 2019, Nuvo Soul blends jazz, soul and funk, inspired by legends like Ella Fitzgerald and Frank Sinatra and modern icons like Amy Winehouse and Bruno Mars. With Carrie on vocals, Joseph on keys and Lance on drums, they read the room and tailor every set, so it's hard to stay still.

deck-0418.jpg.title: Lady J Band
deck-0418.jpg.bio: Lady J and her musical partner Felix have performed over 2,700 shows across Asia and the GCC since 2006, and have been a favourite on Dubai's live music scene since 2015. Moving effortlessly from high-energy pop covers to an intimate jazz duo, they blend live drum loops, guitar and tambourine with French classics, Motown and pop hits. Every show is an emotional journey through nostalgic favourites and exciting new sounds.

deck-0419.jpg.title: De Cruz Band
deck-0419.jpg.bio: Originally from West Africa and based in Dubai since 2015, De Cruz Band is a versatile ensemble performing jazz, Motown, soul, reggae and Afrobeats. They have shared the stage with stars including Akon, Wizkid, Davido, Mi Casa, Patoranking, Tekno and Mr P of P-Square, and perform regularly at luxury hotels and venues across the UAE. Equally brilliant as a trio or a full band, they bring a joyful, dance-floor-filling energy to any event.

deck-0501.jpg.title: Crazy Alchemists
deck-0501.jpg.bio: Ignite curiosity with an explosive, interactive science show for budding scientists and curious minds. Our Crazy Alchemists turn tricky concepts into spectacular, easy-to-follow fun with bubbling potions, colourful reactions and plenty of laughs. A 30-minute show that proves learning can be as exciting as any experiment, perfect for schools, birthday parties and family events.

deck-0502.jpg.title: Face Painting
deck-0502.jpg.bio: Our skilled face painters add a splash of colour and creativity to any celebration, creating everything from playful animals and superheroes to sparkling festive designs. They use only high-quality, skin-safe products for a comfortable, safe experience, and their friendly, engaging style turns every design into a magical memory. Perfect for birthdays, family days, festivals and corporate family events.

deck-0503.jpg.title: Slime Station
deck-0503.jpg.bio: The ultimate hands-on sensory experience, where every child becomes a mad scientist. Kids mix, stir and customise their own batch of colourful, glittery slime with a variety of fun mix-ins, and take it home at the end. A friendly slime attendant guides the creation process throughout, keeping it smooth, safe and fun for all young inventors.

deck-0504.jpg.title: Balloon Twisting
deck-0504.jpg.bio: Our balloon twisters are masters of colourful creations made right before your eyes. Children, and plenty of adults, can request balloon hats, swords, flowers, animals and favourite characters, all made to take home. Interactive, cheerful and guaranteed to bring smiles, they are perfect for birthday parties, school events, family days and festive celebrations.

deck-0505.jpg.title: Mrs Bunny Magic Show
deck-0505.jpg.bio: Step right up! Mrs Bunny welcomes children into a magical wonderland where anything can happen. Bunnies pop up out of thin air, chocolate bottles mysteriously multiply and a surprisingly sassy talking balloon steals the show. A sweet, hilarious 30-minute magic show that keeps kids giggling and gasping from start to finish.

deck-0506.jpg.title: Crazy Kitchen Show
deck-0506.jpg.bio: Get ready for a delicious battle! A madcap Chef and a mischievous Gardener turn their playful rivalry into a stage full of wonder, with spectacular kitchen experiments from freezing frolics to dazzling smoky illusions. A hilarious, interactive 30-minute show that is as enchanting as it is funny, perfect for family events, schools and festive celebrations.

deck-0507.jpg.title: Lauren
deck-0507.jpg.bio: An all-round entertainer from Manchester, Lauren has been singing and dancing in Dubai since 2015. She grew up in a quizzing family, with her dad still hosting the family quiz at every occasion, and has hosted quizzes in Mallorca and Cyprus. Her bubbly personality is infectious, she shines in the music round and loves a good sing-along, so guests laugh all night long.

deck-0508.jpg.title: Ruth
deck-0508.jpg.bio: A former teacher turned quiz host extraordinaire, Ruth brings wit, wisdom and a real knack for engaging audiences to every quiz night. A former singer on the UK pub and club circuit, she has held residencies at popular Dubai venues including Buffalo Wings and Rings, Offside and McCafferty's, and is loved for her enthusiasm and engaging style.

deck-0509.jpg.title: Joseph
deck-0509.jpg.bio: With decades of quiz passion, Joe brings knowledge and energy to every event. He has hosted everything from Euro 2024 specials to weekly quizzes at venues including McGettigan's on the Palm and Lock, Stock & Barrel. Blending fun and intellect, he creates quiz nights full of excitement and laughter, whether guests are trivia newcomers or seasoned pros.

deck-0510.jpg.title: Kevin
deck-0510.jpg.bio: Originally from the UK and in Dubai for over 12 years, Kevin is a confident, engaging host and MC with a talent for making everyone feel included, whatever the size of the event. He has hosted hundreds of quiz nights, bingo events and MC roles, including for Guinness World Records, and is equally at home with a live crowd or a remote audience.

deck-0511.jpg.title: Aaron
deck-0511.jpg.bio: A mastermind of deception with 25 years of experience performing for VIPs, Fortune 500 companies and royalty, Aaron delivers mind reading, impossible predictions and out-of-this-world routines with a warm, engaging style. Drawing on a TV background and expertise in body language, he creates first-class shows and personalised experiences for every audience.

deck-0512.jpg.title: Alister Hypnosis Show
deck-0512.jpg.bio: Something totally different: a fun, fast-paced comedy stage hypnosis show that guests will talk about for years. Volunteers from the audience, usually 12 to 20, are guided into a natural trance and the comedy begins, with routines that see them ride invisible bikes, milk invisible cows and maybe even talk to aliens. Hilarious, interactive and unforgettable.

deck-0513.jpg.title: Magic Phil
deck-0513.jpg.bio: One of the UAE's best-loved children's entertainers, Magic Phil performs at Dubai's top family brunches, malls, schools and events and sells out theatres with his own festive tour every Christmas. Known for his children's radio show on Pearl FM, best-selling children's books and appearances on Nickelodeon, OSN and Dubai One, he leaves a super-silly impression on every little fan.

deck-0514.jpg.title: Yana
deck-0514.jpg.bio: A highly talented UAE-based magician, Yana specialises in both close-up and stage magic. As a leading female magician, she blends classic magic with innovative illusions and captivates audiences with her diverse skills and enchanting performances. A stylish, memorable choice for corporate events, private parties and family celebrations.

deck-0515.jpg.title: Andreea
deck-0515.jpg.bio: For nearly two decades Andreea has been part of the UAE's remarkable growth story, from international modelling and becoming a face of Emirates Airlines to a sought-after professional presenter with over 200 live events. Speaking English and Romanian, she is also a respected speaking coach and mentor, bringing polish and authority to conferences, galas and government events.

deck-0516.jpg.title: May
deck-0516.jpg.bio: An internationally renowned public speaking expert, moderator and facilitator with over 20 years of experience, May speaks Arabic and English and helps individuals and organisations communicate with impact. She has worked with clients across media, technology, real estate, healthcare, automotive, sports and government, making her a superb moderator for conferences and panels.

deck-0517.jpg.title: Sharara
deck-0517.jpg.bio: An MC, presenter, artist, DJ, songwriter and hype-man, Sharara brings huge energy to every stage. Lebanese and based in Dubai, he was the first MC to receive the UAE's ten-year Golden Visa, and his mix of hosting, music and crowd interaction makes him a brilliant choice for concerts, launches, sports events and parties.

deck-0518.jpg.title: Dane
deck-0518.jpg.bio: A well-known British singer, songwriter, DJ and host, Dane trained at the BRIT School and found fame with boy band Another Level, scoring seven UK top 10 singles including the No.1 Freak Me, a platinum debut album and a BRIT Award nomination. Now in Dubai, he brings star power and great energy as a DJ and host.

deck-0519.jpg.title: Jihan
deck-0519.jpg.bio: With a charismatic presence and eloquent delivery, Jihan is a sought-after master of ceremonies for corporate functions and lavish charity galas. She has hosted high-profile events including the Kempinski Floating Palace launch and The St. Regis Residences launch at Atlantis The Royal, keeping every occasion smooth, engaging and memorable.

deck-0520.jpg.title: Rania
deck-0520.jpg.bio: An award-winning bilingual TV presenter and MC, Rania hosts Good News on Alan TV and was named Best Female MC in Dubai and Favourite MC of the Year 2024 by Filmfare. Presenting fluently in Arabic and English, she is regularly requested for events attended by UAE leadership, royal family members and top government officials.

deck-0601.jpg.title: Peacock Hostesses
deck-0601.jpg.bio: Glamorous hostesses in shimmering gowns and jewelled peacock headdresses, creating a striking welcome your guests will remember. They greet and guide guests, pose for photos and add a touch of theatrical luxury to red carpets, gala dinners, hotel openings and brand launches. Costumes can be matched to your theme and colours.

deck-0602.jpg.title: Carnival Dancers
deck-0602.jpg.bio: Dancers from Latin backgrounds, trained in salsa, tango, ballroom and more, with extra training in acro, hip hop and commercial jazz for a modern feel. In full feathered carnival costume, they deliver high-energy routines packed with partner work, lifts and acrobatic tricks, a dazzling showpiece for parties, galas and themed events.

deck-0603.jpg.title: Brazilian Dancers
deck-0603.jpg.bio: Bring the colour and energy of Rio's carnival to your event. Our Brazilian samba dancers perform in spectacular feathered and sequinned costumes, with infectious rhythm and big smiles that get everyone in the party mood. Perfect for Latin nights, welcome moments, parades and celebrations of every kind.

deck-0604.jpg.title: Elegant Carnival Dancers
deck-0604.jpg.bio: Graceful dancers in elegant carnival costumes, combining beautiful choreography with show-stopping style. They can perform a staged routine or roam among guests for photos, making them ideal for themed nights, welcome receptions and moments that need a splash of glamour.

deck-0605.jpg.title: Candy Carnival Performers
deck-0605.jpg.bio: Bright, playful candy-themed dancers and stilt walkers who bring a burst of colour and sweetness to any event. Perfect for family days, children's parties, brand activations and dessert-themed celebrations, they roam, dance and pose for photos with guests of all ages.

deck-0606.jpg.title: Flapper Dancers
deck-0606.jpg.bio: Step back to the roaring twenties with our flapper dancers. Dressed in sparkling fringe and feathers and dancing with dramatic feather fans, they bring the glamour of the jazz age to life. Made for Gatsby parties, art deco themes, New Year's Eve and vintage-style celebrations.

deck-0607.jpg.title: Break Dancers
deck-0607.jpg.bio: These skilful b-boys come fully loaded with tricks. Gather round as they battle it out for the top spot in a high-energy freestyle showdown, or book a choreographed routine for an extra jaw-dropping showpiece. Perfect for youth events, brand launches, festivals and urban-themed parties.

deck-0608.jpg.title: Hip Hop Dancers
deck-0608.jpg.bio: A tight-knit crew that's been performing together for years, with sharp timing and epic moves that leave audiences wanting more. They can freestyle or perform a fully choreographed routine, bringing street-dance energy to launches, festivals, corporate parties and celebrations.

deck-0609.jpg.title: Living Animals
deck-0609.jpg.bio: Body-painted animal performers who prowl, pose and interact with guests, bringing a jungle or safari theme to life in the most theatrical way. Every look is a work of art, and they are guaranteed to be one of the most photographed moments of your event.

deck-0610.jpg.title: Amazon Queen
deck-0610.jpg.bio: A dramatic, feathered jungle queen who makes a show-stopping entrance and creates an unforgettable photo moment. Perfect for jungle, tropical and fantasy themes, she roams among guests, poses for photos and adds real wow factor to any party or brand event.

deck-0611.jpg.title: Jaguars & Panthers
deck-0611.jpg.bio: Sleek big-cat performers in masks and catsuits who prowl through the crowd with feline grace. Mysterious, stylish and wonderfully theatrical, they are perfect for jungle themes, glamorous parties and launches that want an edgy, eye-catching welcome.

deck-0612.jpg.title: Living Tigers
deck-0612.jpg.bio: Stunning body-painted tiger performers who bring a wild, theatrical touch to any event. They roam, pose and interact with guests, creating a striking photo opportunity for jungle themes, Asian-inspired events, brand launches and parties.

deck-0613.jpg.title: Gentleman Lion
deck-0613.jpg.bio: A dapper lion dressed in black tie who meets, greets and charms your guests. Witty, elegant and endlessly photogenic, he is a playful twist on the classic welcome, ideal for galas, jungle-themed parties, hotel events and family celebrations.

deck-0614.jpg.title: Safari Parade
deck-0614.jpg.bio: Giraffe and zebra stilt walkers joined by safari explorers and characters, performing as a full parade or as individual roaming acts. A colourful, larger-than-life way to bring a safari or jungle theme to life at festivals, malls, family days and parties.

deck-0615.jpg.title: Jungle Shuffle
deck-0615.jpg.bio: A colourful jungle-themed show packed with animal characters, available as a stage show or as roaming acts. Fun, energetic and full of personality, it is a hit with children and adults alike at family events, festivals, malls and themed parties.

deck-0616.jpg.title: Mad Hatter's Tea Party
deck-0616.jpg.bio: Fall down the rabbit hole with the Mad Hatter, Alice, the Queen of Hearts and her playing-card soldiers. These whimsical Wonderland characters roam, perform and pose for photos, perfect for tea parties, children's events, brand activations and Alice-themed celebrations.

deck-0617.jpg.title: Dancing Disco Balls
deck-0617.jpg.bio: Roaming disco queens with mirror-ball heads who are fun, vibrant and look absolutely the part. They dance through the crowd, scatter sparkle wherever they go and get guests on the dance floor, made for disco, retro and New Year's Eve parties.

deck-0618.jpg.title: Flower Ladies
deck-0618.jpg.bio: Graceful performers in giant floral costumes who elegantly roam your chosen area, acting and posing for photos with guests. A beautiful touch for garden parties, spring events, weddings, launches and floral-themed celebrations.

deck-0619.jpg.title: Roaming Tables
deck-0619.jpg.bio: Performers wearing elegant table skirts that glide around your event serving drinks, canapés or gifts. An interactive, eye-catching way to welcome guests and hand out anything you like, from champagne to branded giveaways.

deck-0620.jpg.title: Human Statues
deck-0620.jpg.bio: Talented actors painted as living statues, dressed and themed to suit your event. They hold perfectly still before coming to life to surprise and delight guests, creating plenty of laughs and photo moments at galas, launches, festivals and parties.

deck-0621.jpg.title: Lampshade Ladies
deck-0621.jpg.bio: An elegant, slow-gliding roaming act that turns heads wherever it moves. Dressed as beautiful illuminated lampshades, these performers drift through the crowd and pose for photos, a stylish and unusual touch for evening events and design-led parties.

deck-0622.jpg.title: LED Poi Dancers
deck-0622.jpg.bio: Talented female dancers performing perfectly synchronised LED poi routines, with colour-changing lights that can even display your logo. A dazzling feature for brand launches, gala dinners, beach events and any night-time celebration.

deck-0623.jpg.title: Astrobot
deck-0623.jpg.bio: A super-sized jumping-stilt robot that wows every guest and makes an entrance that won't go unnoticed. Perfect for tech launches, futuristic themes, festivals and parties that want maximum impact and plenty of photos.

deck-0624.jpg.title: LED Tron Dancers
deck-0624.jpg.bio: Smoke-breathing Tron dancers who combine LED poi with robotic dance moves in powerful, high-impact costumes. Book them as a stage show or as roaming performers who interact with guests, ideal for launches, tech events and night-time parties.

deck-0625.jpg.title: LED Alien Dancers
deck-0625.jpg.bio: A high-energy LED show from male and female dancers in striking alien-style costumes that will have every head turning. Add LED drums for extra wow, perfect for futuristic themes, festivals, launches and New Year's Eve celebrations.

deck-0626.jpg.title: LED Jumping Stilts
deck-0626.jpg.bio: Super-skilled LED jumping-stilt acrobats who wow guests with flips, jumps and choreographed routines. Glowing, energetic and acrobatic, they are a show-stopping choice for festivals, launches, night events and big celebrations.

deck-0627.jpg.title: LED Robot Dancers
deck-0627.jpg.bio: Get ready for a jaw-dropping LED robot dance show. Add a laser show for even more impact as these glowing robots light up the stage, a guaranteed highlight for launches, corporate parties, festivals and New Year's Eve.

deck-0628.jpg.title: Cyberpunk Robots
deck-0628.jpg.bio: Neon-lit cyberpunk robots that bring a futuristic, high-tech edge to any event. Striking, imposing and endlessly photogenic, they are perfect for tech launches, gaming events, sci-fi themes and night-time parties.

deck-0629.jpg.title: LED Astronauts
deck-0629.jpg.bio: The perfect fit for space, galactic and cyber themes. Our LED astronauts bounce and glide through the party before breaking into fabulous dance routines or freestyle, creating a fun, glowing spectacle guests will love.

deck-0630.jpg.title: Handstand Acrobat
deck-0630.jpg.bio: A graceful hand-balancing act performed on balancing canes, showcasing incredible strength, control and flexibility. Skilful yet beautiful, it is an elegant feature for gala dinners, receptions, launches and stage shows.

deck-0631.jpg.title: Heliosphere
deck-0631.jpg.bio: A breathtaking helium balloon show, by day or night. As the sun sets, the giant balloon glows under spotlights while an acrobat appears to fly through the air beneath it, creating an unforgettable illusion that gets every guest talking. Perfect for outdoor galas, festivals and grand openings.

deck-0632.jpg.title: Hanging Hair Artist
deck-0632.jpg.bio: A unique and daring suspension act performed by only a handful of specialists worldwide, hanging by the hair. It showcases remarkable physical and mental strength alongside impressive flexibility, a true wow moment that can even be combined with the Heliosphere balloon.

deck-0633.jpg.title: Cyr Wheel
deck-0633.jpg.bio: A mesmerising act in which a skilful acrobat spins and twists inside a single large hoop, creating a beautiful, flowing performance. An LED wheel is also available, perfect for night-time events, launches, galas and festivals.

deck-0634.jpg.title: Luis
deck-0634.jpg.bio: An energetic, dynamic diabolo artist and juggler with over 25 years of experience, Luis started out at ten in a theatre company in Spain. His shows connect with audiences of every age, making him a brilliant choice for family events, festivals, malls and corporate celebrations.

deck-0635.jpg.title: Walter
deck-0635.jpg.bio: An Argentine circus artist passionate about every discipline of the circus, Walter blends juggling, clowning and improvisation into charming shows full of poetry, sensitivity and fun. A delightful choice for family events, festivals and audiences who love something a little magical.

deck-0636.jpg.title: Miguel
deck-0636.jpg.bio: A multi-skilled artist who has perfected his craft for over 15 years, Miguel twists and flips while juggling and brings the diabolo and unicycle into his show. Available as a stage show or roaming act, with an LED light show that is perfect for night-time events.

deck-0637.jpg.title: Latino Parade
deck-0637.jpg.bio: A colourful Latin troupe specialising in circus acts for over 20 years, with stilt walkers, jugglers, acrobats, musicians and unicyclists. They connect brilliantly with every audience and adapt to any age group or event type, a joyful parade for festivals, malls and celebrations.

deck-0638.jpg.title: Royal Parade
deck-0638.jpg.bio: Stand to attention for these elegant royal soldiers on stilts, dressed in beautiful uniforms with exquisitely detailed finishes. This parade arrives loud and proud, a grand, eye-catching spectacle for national celebrations, festivals, malls and festive events.

deck-0639.jpg.title: Moroccan Parade
deck-0639.jpg.bio: A multi-skilled troupe of jugglers, stilt walkers, acrobats, unicyclists and dancers in wonderful costumes. Book them as individual acts or as a full parade, and add marching drummers for extra impact at festivals, cultural events and celebrations.

deck-0640.jpg.title: Balancing Balls
deck-0640.jpg.bio: A captivating roaming act in which performers glide around your event balancing on giant balls, interacting and taking photos with guests as they go. They can even juggle while they roam for extra pizzazz, ideal for festivals, malls and family events.

deck-0641.jpg.title: Soccer Parade
deck-0641.jpg.bio: A football-themed troupe of acrobats, dancers, musicians and stilt walkers performing a choreographed show that wows the crowd. Perfect for big sporting events, fan zones, half-time shows and football-themed celebrations.

deck-0642.jpg.title: African Drummers
deck-0642.jpg.bio: A Dubai-based team of African drummers, dancers and acrobats who bring the rhythm and energy of African performance to life. Alongside their shows they run interactive drumming sessions that get guests involved, perfect for festivals, team events and cultural celebrations.

deck-0643.jpg.title: LED Drumming Parade
deck-0643.jpg.bio: If you want to grab your guests' attention, this marching drumming band will do it. Their glowing costumes can be seen from afar at night and their thunderous warrior drums draw everyone in, a powerful opening for festivals, launches and night-time events.

deck-0644.jpg.title: LED Drummers
deck-0644.jpg.bio: A high-energy LED drum show that lights up the room, perfect alongside a DJ or as a feature performance. Glowing drums, sharp choreography and pounding rhythms make it a show-stopping highlight for parties, launches and New Year's Eve.

deck-0645.jpg.title: Shams
deck-0645.jpg.bio: A full-time professional caricaturist working in traditional pencil and charcoal on paper and in colour on tablet. Living and working in Dubai for over 16 years, he draws guests in just minutes, creating fun personalised keepsakes for weddings, corporate events and parties.

deck-0646.jpg.title: Sara
deck-0646.jpg.bio: An artist and fashion illustrator who has worked with leading names including Bloomingdale's, Harvey Nichols and Estée Lauder. Trained at Leith School of Art with a degree in fashion design and technology, she sketches guests live to create elegant keepsakes for luxury events, launches and weddings.

deck-0701.jpg.title: Benna Band
deck-0701.jpg.bio: Named after the Tunisian word for 'tastes good', Benna Band has blended diverse musical genres into a unique, celebratory sound since 2016. They have performed at the Sharjah, Sikka and Wasla festivals and toured Lebanon, Kuwait, Tunisia and Saudi Arabia, earning TV appearances and recognition for their work. A joyful choice for Ramadan nights, cultural events and celebrations.

deck-0702.jpg.title: Jad Duo
deck-0702.jpg.bio: Oud player and singer Jad joins forces with percussionist Qayes for a duo rooted in Middle Eastern tradition with a contemporary edge. Jad has performed at the Damascus Opera House and TUNES DXB, while Qayes is known for blending classic rhythms with modern fusion. Together they create warm, soulful music perfect for iftars, suhoors and cultural evenings.

deck-0703.jpg.title: Lubna & Aida
deck-0703.jpg.bio: Arabic vocalist Lubna and qanun player Aida form an extraordinary duo loved by audiences across the Arab world. Lubna's rich, soulful voice and mastery of the maqamat meet the shimmering tones of Aida's qanun in a performance full of emotion, technique and tradition, both timeless and fresh. A beautiful choice for Ramadan gatherings and elegant evenings.

deck-0704.jpg.title: Hooman Ensemble
deck-0704.jpg.bio: Led by accomplished musician Hooman, this ensemble brings the beauty of Persian and Arabic classical music to life with oud, vocals, qanun and percussion. Hooman has performed at the Al Wasl Dome at Expo 2020 and in concerts across India, Tunisia and beyond, and the ensemble creates a rich, atmospheric sound for Ramadan events and cultural celebrations.

deck-0705.jpg.title: Gharbi Twins
deck-0705.jpg.bio: Twin brothers Mohamed on violin and Bechir on oud are a dynamic duo known for extraordinary talent and powerful performances. They blend traditional Arabic sounds with global influences into a captivating fusion, full of technique, emotion and perfect synergy. A standout act for Ramadan events, cultural festivals and private celebrations across the UAE.

deck-0706.jpg.title: Sadeq
deck-0706.jpg.bio: Sadeq grew up beside the workshop of master oud maker Adnan Abdul Rahman, who took the curious young musician under his wing and taught him both how to make and how to play the oud. That lifelong devotion shines through in his deeply expressive playing, rooted in tradition and full of soul, perfect for Ramadan nights and refined cultural events.

deck-0707.jpg.title: Saif
deck-0707.jpg.bio: A distinguished Emirati musician inspired by legends such as Mohammed Abdel Wahab and Umm Kulthum, Saif has crafted a unique identity in contemporary Arabic music. Classically trained on piano and oud, he blends Eastern and Emirati traditions across genres and languages, creating a harmonious fusion of heritage and modernity that is perfect for Ramadan and national celebrations.

deck-0708.jpg.title: Mahrat
deck-0708.jpg.bio: A multi-instrumentalist with over a decade of experience, Mahrat plays seven instruments including oud, saz, baglama, guitar, keys and percussion, and is known for blending popular Arabic and Western styles. He has performed at festivals across Syria, Jordan, Lebanon, Egypt, Oman and the UAE, and at luxury hotels including the Ritz-Carlton Abu Dhabi and Shangri-La Muscat.

deck-0709.jpg.title: Sam
deck-0709.jpg.bio: An accomplished oud player, musician and vocalist, Sam has toured widely and recorded with many artists across the Middle East. Comfortable in maqam, oriental, traditional and folk styles as well as Latin, jazz, blues, funk and pop, he also composes and arranges original music, making him a versatile choice for Ramadan events, corporate occasions and private gatherings.

deck-0710.jpg.title: Jad
deck-0710.jpg.bio: A talented oud player and singer from Damascus now based in the UAE, Jad has performed at the Damascus Opera House and TUNES DXB 2024. Passionate about music's power to connect, he has trained refugee youth choirs in Syria and Lebanon and collaborated with poets in the UAE, bringing warmth and heart to every performance.

deck-0711.jpg.title: Fady
deck-0711.jpg.bio: A distinguished Egyptian oud master with over a decade of experience, Fady also plays violin, qanun, nay and guitar, making him a rare and versatile talent in Arabic music. Now established in the UAE as both a sought-after performer and a respected teacher, he brings depth and authenticity to Ramadan events, weddings and cultural celebrations.

deck-0712.jpg.title: Yahia
deck-0712.jpg.bio: A Dubai-based oud master, Yahia captivates audiences with soulful melodies and intricate fingerwork, blending classical technique with contemporary influences. He sings beautifully and can also freestyle alongside a DJ for a modern twist, turning every performance into an immersive journey to the heart of the Middle East.

deck-0713.jpg.title: Hooman
deck-0713.jpg.bio: A talented oud player and composer, Hooman has dedicated his life to mastering the oud. His original compositions blend classical Middle Eastern melodies with innovative modern influences, reflecting a deep understanding of music theory and cultural heritage, and his performances bring a rich, contemplative atmosphere to Ramadan events and elegant evenings.

deck-0714.jpg.title: Khaled
deck-0714.jpg.bio: A highly accomplished UAE-based oud player, Khaled has created unforgettable musical experiences at corporate events, weddings and upscale venues since 2013. His range spans traditional Arabic classics and Khaliji music to deep house fusion, blues and jazz, and he is an award-winning virtuoso known for tailoring every performance to his audience.

deck-0715.jpg.title: Mayyas
deck-0715.jpg.bio: A talented oud player and music teacher based in the UAE, Mayyas is passionate about preserving the rich heritage of the oud while embracing contemporary styles. She brings emotional depth to classical Arabic compositions with her own unique flair, and her graceful performances are perfect for Ramadan gatherings and cultural events.

deck-0716.jpg.title: Yamen
deck-0716.jpg.bio: A UAE-based musician, composer and oud player, Yamen blends classical styles with modern influences in a rich, versatile approach to the instrument. A dedicated teacher as well as a performer, he creates original music that reflects a deep understanding of Arabic musical heritage, ideal for Ramadan nights and refined events.

deck-0717.jpg.title: Abdulkader
deck-0717.jpg.bio: A skilled UAE-based qanun player renowned for his mastery of traditional Arabic music, Abdulkader has performed at concerts, weddings and cultural festivals across the UAE and the Middle East, collaborating with renowned artists and orchestras. His emotional depth and technical brilliance make every performance special.

deck-0718.jpg.title: Abdalla
deck-0718.jpg.bio: An Egyptian qanun player with 12 years of experience, Abdalla began in the band of star Nesma Mahgoub and has since performed in Russia, Austria, Saudi Arabia, Morocco, Oman and Tunisia with Arabic superstars including Ahlam and Kadim Al Sahir. Winner of the Ebdaa competition's first solo prize and a UAE Golden Visa holder, he blends traditional, fusion and Khaliji styles.

deck-0719.jpg.title: Kenan
deck-0719.jpg.bio: A highly skilled Dubai-based qanun player with over 13 years of professional experience, Kenan performs solo and with diverse ensembles. His captivating performances blend traditional Arabic music with influences from many cultures, making him a superb choice for multicultural events, Ramadan gatherings and elegant evenings.

deck-0720.jpg.title: Maya
deck-0720.jpg.bio: A gifted Syrian qanun player with a degree in music education, Maya has captivated audiences across Bahrain, Saudi Arabia and Dubai with her blend of Eastern and Western styles. She has shared the stage with renowned musicians, preserving the traditions of the qanun while bringing fresh innovation to every performance.

deck-0721.jpg.title: Ahmed
deck-0721.jpg.bio: A talented Dubai-based qanun player, Ahmed is known for his exceptional skill and deep passion for classical Arabic music. He combines technical mastery with emotional depth, captivating audiences at prestigious venues and events across the region with intricate melodies and soulful playing.

deck-0722.jpg.title: Qayes
deck-0722.jpg.bio: A Dubai-based percussionist who blends traditional Middle Eastern rhythms with global styles, Qayes holds a UAE Golden Visa for culture and art and is a member of the UAE Musicians Association. He has performed everywhere from Emirates Palace to major sporting events and Miss World, and is a favourite for brand activations and live sets with DJs.

deck-0723.jpg.title: Charlotte
deck-0723.jpg.bio: A Dubai-based artist and designer trained in theatre design in the UK, Charlotte creates beautiful personalised designs through live art, customisation, wearable art and illustration. She has collaborated with luxury brands at exclusive events and on private commissions, offering guests a stylish, interactive keepsake.

deck-0724.jpg.title: Arabic Calligraphy
deck-0724.jpg.bio: Our talented calligrapher creates intricate bespoke pieces inspired by themes of peace, gratitude and spirituality, transforming words into art. Guests can watch the elegant script come to life or receive personalised names and messages, making it a meaningful activation for iftars, corporate gatherings and cultural events.

deck-0725.jpg.title: Sand Bottle Art
deck-0725.jpg.bio: Our skilled sand bottle artist layers colourful sand into intricate designs, creating unique keepsakes filled with meaningful symbols and motifs. Guests can watch the process unfold or craft their own personalised bottles, a captivating, interactive activation for Ramadan events and family gatherings.

deck-0726.jpg.title: Henna Art
deck-0726.jpg.bio: Skilled henna artists create beautiful, intricate designs that celebrate the cultural significance of henna in Middle Eastern traditions. Guests can be adorned with a stunning design or simply watch the artistry in action, an elegant, much-loved activation for Ramadan, Eid, weddings and ladies' events.

deck-0727.jpg.title: Basket Weaving
deck-0727.jpg.bio: Discover the ancient art of Arabic basket weaving as skilled artisans intertwine palm fronds into beautiful, functional pieces using techniques passed down through generations. Guests can learn the craft and take home their own hand-woven creation, a meaningful heritage activation for Ramadan and national celebrations.

deck-0728.jpg.title: Clay Pottery
deck-0728.jpg.bio: Skilled artisans demonstrate the rich history and craftsmanship of traditional Arabic clay pottery, shaping and decorating pieces before guests' eyes. Hands-on workshops let everyone create their own piece to take home, a wonderful cultural experience for Ramadan events, family days and team activities.

deck-0729.jpg.title: Arabic Coffee Serving
deck-0729.jpg.bio: Experience the aromatic tradition of qahwa, served ceremonially from elegant dallahs by trained servers and accompanied by dates and sweet treats. A warm expression of Arabian hospitality that brings authenticity to iftars, receptions, Ramadan gatherings and national day celebrations.

deck-0730.jpg.title: Luqaimat Serving
deck-0730.jpg.bio: Golden, crispy luqaimat dumplings, freshly made and drizzled with date syrup or honey. A beloved Ramadan treat that embodies the spirit of togetherness, perfect for iftar gatherings, suhoors, family events and celebrations that want a taste of Emirati tradition.

deck-0731.jpg.title: Date Expert
deck-0731.jpg.bio: Our date expert and storyteller brings the rich cultural heritage of dates to life, sharing fascinating stories about their history, varieties and role in traditional dishes. Guests taste and learn in an engaging experience that celebrates one of the region's most cherished foods, ideal for Ramadan and cultural events.

deck-0732.jpg.title: Falcon Display
deck-0732.jpg.bio: Skilled falconers showcase their magnificent birds of prey and the art of falconry, a treasured part of Arabian heritage. Guests learn about the history, training and care of falcons while admiring their grace and power, an unforgettable cultural highlight for Ramadan events, national celebrations and VIP gatherings.

deck-0733.jpg.title: Eagle Display
deck-0733.jpg.bio: A trained eagle perched proudly on its handler's arm, creating a striking and impressive presence at any event. A memorable photo moment with real visual impact, ideal for corporate events, ceremonies, national celebrations and special occasions.

deck-0734.jpg.title: Hakawati Storyteller
deck-0734.jpg.bio: Let the enchanting voice of our hakawati transport guests to a world of wonder. Steeped in the cultural heritage of the Arab world, the storyteller shares timeless tales celebrating the values and traditions of Ramadan, an intimate, immersive experience for iftars, majlis evenings and family gatherings.

deck-0735.jpg.title: Majlis Tent
deck-0735.jpg.bio: A beautifully adorned majlis tent with plush seating, rich fabrics and intricate décor, creating a warm, welcoming space for guests to gather. Perfect for iftars, suhoors and Ramadan activations, it brings the spirit of reflection, connection and hospitality to life.

deck-0736.jpg.title: Sufi Dance
deck-0736.jpg.bio: Performers in flowing robes spin gracefully to the gentle rhythms of live music, creating an atmosphere of tranquillity and reflection. Rooted in rich mystical traditions, Sufi dance is a spellbinding, spiritual performance that beautifully honours the essence of Ramadan and cultural celebrations.

deck-0737.jpg.title: Tanoura Dance
deck-0737.jpg.bio: Dancers in vibrant, swirling multi-layered skirts create a dazzling visual spectacle as they twirl to the rhythm of live music. A mesmerising tradition symbolising harmony and peace, Tanoura is a perfect highlight for Ramadan gatherings, cultural evenings and festivals.

deck-0738.jpg.title: Ayala Dance
deck-0738.jpg.bio: Emirati Ayala dancers in their finest traditional attire perform this iconic heritage dance with intricate formations, rhythmic movement and traditional music. A proud celebration of the UAE's culture, perfect for Ramadan, national day, government events and cultural celebrations.

deck-0739.jpg.title: Dabke Dance
deck-0739.jpg.bio: Full of infectious energy and lively footwork, traditional Dabke brings people together in joyful celebration. Dancers in elegant costume perform to traditional music in a vibrant display of colour and movement, the perfect way to kick off Ramadan gatherings, weddings and cultural events.
